title: Digital Marketing Executive (SEO & Performance Marketing)
description:
**Company:**
Passion Minds Pvt. Ltd.

**Location:**
Pune, Maharashtra

**Job Type:**
Full-time | Work from Office

**Experience:**
2 to 3 Years Preferred

**Salary:**
₹30,000 to ₹35,000 per month

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Digital Marketing Executive with hands-on experience in SEO, Google Ads and Meta Ads.

The candidate should be able to independently manage digital marketing campaigns, improve website visibility, optimise ad performance, track leads and conversions, and prepare meaningful performance reports.

**Key Responsibilities**

**SEO**

* Conduct keyword research, on-page SEO and basic technical SEO audits.
* Plan and execute off-page SEO activities.
* Monitor organic traffic, keyword rankings and website performance.
* Identify opportunities to improve search visibility, traffic and enquiries.
* Coordinate with content and development teams for SEO improvements.

**Google Ads & Meta Ads**

* Plan, create, manage and optimise Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns.
* Manage campaign budgets, targeting, keywords and audience selection.
* Track leads, conversions, cost per lead and campaign performance.
* Implement conversion tracking using GA4, Google Tag Manager and platform tracking tools.
* Conduct A/B testing and recommend improvements.

**Reporting & Coordination**

* Prepare monthly SEO and paid advertising performance reports.
* Analyse campaign results and recommend practical next steps.
* Coordinate with designers, content writers and developers.
* Manage assigned client activities and meet deadlines.

**Required Skills**

* Hands-on experience with SEO, Google Ads and Meta Ads.
* Working knowledge of Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console and Google Tag Manager.
* Experience in campaign optimisation, conversion tracking and lead generation.
* Ability to interpret performance data and take corrective action.
* Good communication, coordination and reporting skills.

**Good to Have**

* Experience in a digital marketing agency.
* Experience handling multiple client accounts.
* Exposure to B2B or industrial marketing.
* Familiarity with WordPress, SEMrush, Ahrefs or similar tools.

**How to Apply**

Apply through LinkedIn with your updated CV, current CTC, expected CTC and notice period.

title: Marketing Intern (B2B SaaS, Content & SEO)
description:
**About ArcSetu:**

ArcSetu is an Indian software company that builds operations software for interior design and construction firms. Our first product, Niti, runs a firm from first enquiry to final bill: leads, BOQs and estimates, Gantt schedules, material requests and purchase orders, site inventory, approvals, running bills and GST-ready accounts. It also includes Niti Copilot, an AI assistant that answers questions from project data and shows its sources.

Construction runs on money and trust. Niti is built so that every total, approval and stock movement can be traced back to where it came from. We are a small team that ships carefully and spends time on site with our users.

**About the Role:**

You will help tell that story to interior designers, fit-out firms, contractors and developers across India. You'll work with the founders on content, SEO, social media and launch campaigns, and see exactly how your work turns into demo requests.

**What you will do:**

* Plan and write posts for LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube about site operations, BOQs, purchasing, GST and project control
* Create short product videos, screen recordings and carousels that show real Niti workflows (for example: site request → purchase order → goods receipt)
* Write blog posts and landing page copy for arcsetu.com/niti, optimised for Google search and AI search (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity)
* Do keyword and competitor research on construction and interior project-management software
* Interview customers and site teams and turn them into case studies and testimonials
* Shoot or source on-site photos and video during field visits
* Build email newsletters and simple campaigns for leads in the pipeline
* Research trade fairs, design events and industry communities where our buyers gather
* Track reach, website traffic and demo sign-ups weekly, and report what is working

**What we are looking for?**

* A graduate with 0 to 1 year of experience (Mass Communication, BBA, MBA Marketing, B.Des, B.Arch or any field)
* Strong written English; you can explain a technical idea simply, without jargon
* A portfolio, blog or social account that shows your writing or design work
* Comfortable with Canva or Figma and basic video editing (CapCut, Premiere or similar)
* Curious about how construction and interior projects actually get built

**Good to have**

* Basic SEO knowledge (Google Search Console, Google Analytics, keyword tools)
* Experience with B2B or SaaS content
* Hindi writing skills for regional campaigns
* Background or interest in architecture, interior design or civil engineering

**What you get**

* Stipend of ₹10,000 per month
* Pre-placement offer (PPO) for strong performers
* Internship certificate and letter of recommendation
* Published work under your name for your portfolio
* Hands-on experience marketing a B2B SaaS product from an early stage
* Direct mentorship from the founders

**Duration**
: 3 months, hybrid (Pune office + site visits)

**Start date**
: 16 November 2026

**How to Apply:**

Apply on LinkedIn or email your CV and portfolio to career@arcsetu.com.

Share one piece of content you made that you're proud of, and one idea for a LinkedIn post about Niti.

title: Sales & Marketing Coordinator
description:
**VACANCY FOR SALES & MARKETING COORDINATOR**

**About Revata Engineering**

Established in 2009, Revata Engineering Pvt. Ltd. is an ISO 9001:2015 certified manufacturing company serving the Oil & Gas and other engineering industries. We specialise in high-performance elastomer solutions, industrial sealing products, custom-moulded rubber components and application-specific engineered products.

**About the Position**

We are looking for a
**Sales & Marketing Coordinator**
with a technical background and experience in handling customer enquiries, preparing quotations and coordinating orders. The candidate should be comfortable understanding customer requirements, reviewing technical drawings and specifications, discussing suitable materials and product applications, and working with internal teams to develop appropriate solutions.

The role involves regular interaction with customers in India and overseas, along with close coordination with our Engineering, Production, Quality, Purchase and other departments. The selected candidate will report directly to the Managing Director.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Customer Enquiries & Technical Coordination**

* Handle customer enquiries and RFQs, including technical and commercial discussions.
* Review drawings, specifications, samples and other customer requirements.
* Identify missing technical details and obtain necessary clarifications from customers.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Design and other departments to evaluate requirements and product feasibility.
* Maintain proper records of customer enquiries and follow-ups.

**2. Material Selection & Application Support**

* Understand customer applications and suggest suitable elastomer and polymer materials such as NBR, HNBR, FKM, FFKM, AFLAS, PTFE, PEEK, etc.
* Discuss application conditions such as pressure, temperature, fluid compatibility and other performance requirements.
* Coordinate with the Engineering, R&D and Laboratory teams for technical recommendations and product development.
* Assist customers in resolving technical queries related to product selection, design and performance.

**3. Quotations & Order Conversion**

* Prepare techno-commercial quotations in coordination with the Engineering, Costing and Production teams.
* Ensure quotations include relevant technical details, pricing, tooling charges, delivery schedules, payment terms and other commercial conditions.
* Follow up with customers on submitted quotations and work towards converting enquiries into orders.
* Handle price negotiations and commercial discussions wherever required.
* Maintain records of quotations, customer responses and order conversion.

**4. Order Processing & Internal Coordination**

* Review customer purchase orders against submitted quotations and agreed terms.
* Verify technical specifications, quantities, prices, delivery schedules and other order requirements.
* Coordinate with Production, Purchase, Quality and other departments for smooth order execution.
* Keep customers informed about order progress, delivery schedules and any changes.
* Coordinate customer approvals, inspection requirements and documentation wherever applicable.

**5. Product Development & Customer Trials**

* Coordinate with Engineering and NPD teams for development of new and customised products.
* Assist in reverse-engineering projects involving customer samples and existing components.
* Follow up on sample development, product trials, testing and customer approvals.
* Collect customer feedback and coordinate necessary improvements with the technical teams.

**6. Customer Relationship Management & After-Sales Support**

* Maintain regular communication with existing customers and develop strong working relationships.
* Handle customer queries, complaints and after-sales requirements.
* Coordinate with Quality and Engineering teams for investigation and resolution of product-related complaints.
* Follow up on corrective actions and ensure timely communication with customers.

**7. Business Development**

* Identify new business opportunities with existing and potential customers.
* Promote Revata's products and manufacturing capabilities across different industries and applications.
* Coordinate customer visits, technical meetings and product presentations.
* Gather market information, customer requirements and competitor feedback.
* Support business development activities in domestic and international markets.

**8. Sales Reporting & Documentation**

* Maintain updated records of enquiries, quotations, orders and customer communications.
* Track pending quotations, customer follow-ups and potential business opportunities.
* Prepare periodic sales reports and updates for management.
* Ensure all relevant information is properly maintained in the company's CRM/ERP system.

**9. Marketing & Exhibitions**

* Assist in organising and participating in trade exhibitions, industrial events and customer meetings.
* Follow up on leads and enquiries generated through exhibitions and marketing activities.
* Support the preparation of company presentations, product brochures and other marketing materials.
* Coordinate with the graphic designer and internal teams for marketing-related activities.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Polymer Engineering, Rubber Technology, Petroleum Engineering or a related field.
* **3–5 years of relevant experience**
  in technical sales, sales coordination, application engineering or a similar customer-facing role in a manufacturing company.
* Preference will be given to candidates with experience in elastomers, industrial seals, rubber products, engineering components or Oil & Gas equipment.
* Ability to read and understand engineering drawings, technical specifications and dimensional tolerances.
* Basic understanding of elastomer and polymer materials, their properties and industrial applications.
* Good technical understanding with the ability to communicate effectively with customers and internal engineering teams.
* Strong communication, interpersonal, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Good working knowledge of MS Office, particularly Excel, Word and Outlook.
* Good command of written and spoken English.
* Willingness to travel within India and occasionally overseas for customer visits and exhibitions.

**Additional Preferences**

Candidates having the following experience or knowledge will be preferred:

* Exposure to Oil & Gas equipment, downhole tools, packers, pressure-control equipment and sealing applications.
* Experience dealing with international customers, export enquiries and commercial terms.
* Basic understanding of seal design, material selection and product applications.
* Experience working with CRM or ERP systems.
* Ability to communicate in Hindi and Marathi.

**Location:**
M.I.D.C., Bhosari, Pune – 411026

Monday to Saturday

8:30 AM to 5:30 PM

**Remuneration:**
CTC will be commensurate with qualifications, experience and industry standards.

Interested candidates may email their updated resume to
**revata.hr@gmail.com**
, mentioning
**“Application for Sales & Marketing Coordinator”**
in the subject line.

Candidates are requested not to call the company's mainline for recruitment enquiries. Recruitment-related calls will not be entertained.

* Own and drive the integrated roadmap and prioritized portfolio across GRC platforms, workflows, AI, continuous controls monitoring, digital guidance, learning, adoption and data quality.
* Translate GRC strategy and approved framework requirements into clear capabilities, sequenced releases, dependencies, resource requirements and measurable outcomes.
* Lead and develop Platform Managers, Digital Enablement Managers and the Data Quality Manager, establishing clear product ownership and delivery standards.
* Personally lead complex initiatives that bring together platform, data, AI, workflow, controls and adoption requirements.
* Act as the senior functional product authority for the GRC digital landscape, ensuring standardization, architecture alignment, auditability and a strong end-to-end user experience.
* Govern portfolio intake, business cases, prioritization, design decisions, acceptance criteria, testing, release readiness, adoption and continuous improvement.
* Partner closely with engineering teams on build capacity, technical dependencies, operational support, incident resolution and sustainable product ownership.
* Establish robust data-quality rules, reconciliations, ownership and exception processes to support trusted workflows, analytics and management reporting.
* Establish responsible AI and automation guardrails, including appropriate human oversight, traceability, explainability and quality controls.

**Core Comptencies:**

* Proven leadership experience managing enterprise GRC platforms, preferably SAP GRC solutions, and digital product portfolios.
* Deep expertise in GRC processes, controls, workflow design, and governance architecture.
* Demonstrated experience delivering AI, automation, and continuous controls monitoring capabilities at scale.
* Strong knowledge of SAP GRC Process Control, including data governance, data quality, and management reporting.
* Ability to lead and develop teams while personally driving complex cross-functional transformation and adoption initiatives.

**What We Are Looking For:**

* 15+ years of relevant professional experience, with significant experience across GRC, digital platforms, technology-enabled transformation, product management, risk, controls or related areas.
* Strong experience in digital product and portfolio leadership, including roadmap prioritization and value management.
* Good understanding of GRC platforms, workflow architecture and digitally enabled risk and compliance processes.
* Experience working with AI and automation, with an understanding of responsible governance, human oversight, traceability and quality controls.
* Strong understanding of data governance, data quality and associated controls.
* Experience driving digital adoption, self-service capabilities and service design.
* Demonstrated ability to operate effectively across business and technology teams and influence senior stakeholders.
* Strong people leadership capabilities, combined with the ability and willingness to remain hands-on in the delivery of complex initiatives.

**Key Stakeholder Relationships:**
The role will work closely with:
  
  

* Head of GRC Standards, Platform and Reporting
* Platform Managers
* Digital Enablement Managers
* Data Quality Manager
* Governance & Standard and Data & Reporting roles
* Product, Platform and Engineering teams
* GPLs, FPOs and first-line users
* PEX, A&I and external auditors

**Measures of Success:**
Success in this role will be measured through:
  
  

* Delivery of portfolio milestones
* Requirement-to-release cycle time
* Release quality and critical defects
* Platform availability and incident trends
* Self-service and active adoption
* Data-quality rule pass rates
* Reduction in manual effort
* User confidence and support demand

**What You Will Be Accountable For:**
You will be accountable for maintaining an integrated and prioritized roadmap across platform, AI, self-service, adoption and data quality; ensuring the functional quality, usability, auditability and adoption of GRC digital products; maintaining reliable data controls; and ensuring responsible governance of AI and automation with appropriate human oversight

title: Web Director, Digital Experience
description:

**Web Director, Digital Experience**
We're looking for a proven Web Director to own the strategic direction, performance, and evolution of Qualys.com as a revenue-driving engine. * Personalization Strategy: Design and direct the strategy for using behavioral and audience data to serve tailored content and experiences to key segments.
* Technical Direction: Guide the web development team's priorities and technical approach, translating business goals into a clear execution plan they can build against.
* Cross-Functional Leadership: Represent web strategy to marketing, product, sales, and executive stakeholders; resolve competing priorities at the roadmap level rather than case by case.
* Global Strategy: Set direction for multi-language support, international SEO, and region-specific experience strategy.
* Security & Compliance: Ensure that the website meets all required global standards for compliance and regulation.
* Brand & Experience Standards: Partner with Brand/Creative to ensure the site's direction and user experience reflect the company's positioning and visual identity.
* Team Leadership: Manage and actively develop the people on the web team by providing hands-on technical and strategic guidance.

**Requirements**

* 10+ years in digital/web leadership, including 3+ years specifically in a director-level (or equivalent) role owning a corporate website or digital product.
* Verifiable track record of personally leading a website redesign, platform migration, or comparable large-scale initiative end to end.
* Direct experience managing a technical or web development team.
* Demonstrated history of defining and driving KPI/CRO programs with measurable results (be ready to discuss specific outcomes).
* Experience operating cross-functionally with executive-level stakeholders.
* B2B experience required; cybersecurity industry experience strongly preferred.

* CMS & Hosting: Modern JavaScript framework experience (Next.js/React strongly preferred), hosted on a CDN/edge platform such as Netlify.
* Analytics: Google Analytics 4 (GA4).
* A/B Testing & Experimentation: Experience with an A/B testing platform (Optimizely, VWO, or similar).
* Behavioral & Session Analytics: Experience with a behavioral/session analytics tool (Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, or similar).
* Reporting & BI: Looker Studio or Tableau.
* Project Management: Asana or similar.
* Cookie Consent & Privacy Compliance: Experience with a cookie consent/compliance platform (Cookiebot or similar).

title: Digital Marketing Intern
description:
Digital Marketing Intern
  
  
Last Minutes Deal | Remote | 3-Month Internship
  
  
Company Description
  
Last Minutes Deal is a specialized marketplace for last-minute stays, connecting travelers with hotels, resorts, villas, camps, motels, and other accommodations offering last-minute availability. The platform simplifies the discovery and booking of nearby stays, helping travelers explore convenient options while enabling accommodation partners to reach more customers.
  
  
As an emerging travel tech startup, Last Minutes Deal offers an opportunity to work at the intersection of digital marketing, hospitality, technology, and brand building. Interns will gain practical exposure to startup marketing, creative content production, customer acquisition, and digital brand growth.
  
  
Role Description
  
We are looking for a creative, enthusiastic, and digitally savvy Digital Marketing Intern who wants to develop practical marketing skills while working with a growing travel tech startup.
  
  
This is a three month unpaid remote internship designed to provide hands-on learning in social media marketing, content creation, graphic designing, short form video production, and digital campaign execution.
  
  
You will work closely with the team to develop engaging content, create promotional creatives, improve social media presence, explore marketing trends, and contribute to building the Last Minutes Deal brand.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
- Social Media Marketing: Assist in managing Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and other relevant social media platforms.
  
- Canva Designing: Create attractive social media posts, promotional banners, stories, reels covers, carousels, and other marketing creatives using Canva.
  
- Video Creation and Editing: Create engaging short-form videos, Instagram Reels, promotional videos, travel content, and property showcase videos using tools such as CapCut, Canva, or similar editing software.
  
- Content Creation: Develop creative captions, post ideas, travel-related content, campaign concepts, and brand communication.
  
- Digital Marketing Campaigns: Support the planning and execution of social media campaigns, audience engagement initiatives, and customer acquisition activities.
  
- Trend Research: Identify trending audio, reels formats, content styles, hashtags, and digital marketing opportunities relevant to travel and hospitality.
  
- Brand Building: Help maintain a consistent brand identity across digital platforms and contribute new ideas to strengthen online visibility.
  
- Performance Tracking: Monitor social media engagement, reach, impressions, follower growth, and content performance using platform insights and spreadsheets.
  
- Marketing Research: Research competitors, target audiences, travel trends, and content strategies to identify growth opportunities.
  
- Campaign Collaboration: Work with the team on promotional campaigns, creative experiments, and new marketing initiatives.
  
  
Skills and Qualifications
  
- Basic understanding of digital marketing and social media platforms.
  
- Practical knowledge of Canva for creating social media posts, banners, and marketing creatives.
  
- Interest or experience in video creation and editing for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and other short-form formats.
  
- Creativity and an eye for visual design, typography, layouts, and storytelling.
  
- Good written communication skills for captions, content ideas, and promotional messaging.
  
- Understanding of Instagram trends, social media engagement, and content formats.
  
- Familiarity with tools such as CapCut, VN, Canva Video, Meta Business Suite, or similar tools is an advantage.
  
- Willingness to learn content strategy, digital marketing analytics, campaign planning, and audience growth techniques.
  
- Ability to work independently, manage deadlines, accept feedback, and collaborate remotely.
  
- Students, freshers, and recent graduates from Marketing, Digital Marketing, Media, Design, Communications, or related fields are encouraged to apply.
  
  
A strong portfolio is welcome, but not mandatory. We value creativity, consistency, curiosity, and a willingness to learn.
  
  
What You Will Learn
  
- Practical digital marketing experience in a growing startup.
  
- Social media content planning and execution.
  
- Professional Canva designing and creative development.
  
- Short-form video creation, editing, and storytelling.
  
- Brand positioning and digital communication.
  
- Content calendars, campaign planning, and marketing strategy.
  
- Social media analytics, engagement tracking, and performance reporting.
  
- Understanding customer acquisition and organic growth strategies.
  
- Exposure to travel-tech, hospitality, and online marketplace business models.
  
- Collaboration, creative problem-solving, and working in a fast-moving startup environment.
  
  
Internship Details
  
- Duration: 3 months
  
- Work Mode: Remote
  
- Opportunity: Hands on learning and practical project experience
  
- Ideal Candidates: Students, freshers, and aspiring digital marketers who want to build their skills and portfolio.
  
  
Who Should Apply?
  
  
If you enjoy creating Instagram posts, designing in Canva, editing videos, exploring social media trends, and experimenting with creative marketing ideas, this internship is an opportunity to turn your interest into practical experience.
  
  
Join Last Minutes Deal and contribute to building a growing travel-tech brand while developing skills that can support your future career in digital marketing.
  
  
Apply now to learn, create, experiment, and grow with us.

Pune

1–3 years

Full-time

Marketing Head

About LeaderNovo

LeaderNovo is a talent and organisational development company helping organisations make informed people decisions and strengthen workplace capabilities.

Our offerings include psychometric and talent assessments, leadership development solutions, organisational culture diagnostics, and AI-enabled learning and development platforms.

We work with HR, L&D, talent management, and business leaders to address challenges in talent selection, leadership readiness, sales effectiveness, employee development, and organisational culture.

About the Role

We are looking for a creative, resourceful, and execution-oriented marketing professional who can turn marketing strategies into impactful campaigns and engaging communication.

Working closely with the Marketing Head, you will develop campaign ideas, create compelling content, coordinate marketing activities, and drive initiatives that increase awareness, engagement, and qualified business enquiries for LeaderNovo's products and services.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys both
**thinking creatively and getting things done**
.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Campaign Ideation & Execution**

* Translate product marketing objectives into actionable campaign ideas and plans.
* Propose creative ways to promote LeaderNovo's assessments, platforms, and services to relevant B2B audiences.
* Plan and execute campaigns across LinkedIn, email, WhatsApp, website, and other relevant channels.
* Develop campaign calendars, coordinate deliverables, and ensure timely execution.
* Experiment with new content formats, messaging approaches, and campaign ideas.

**2. Marketing Communication & Content Creation**

* Write engaging and persuasive content for LinkedIn posts, carousels, email campaigns, brochures, presentations, and landing pages.
* Develop attention-grabbing headlines, campaign hooks, product messaging, and calls to action.
* Simplify complex product information into clear, relevant, and benefit-led communication.
* Maintain consistency in LeaderNovo's brand voice across marketing materials.
* Research industry trends, audience challenges, and relevant topics to identify content opportunities.

**3. Digital Marketing & Lead Generation**

* Execute organic and paid digital marketing initiatives in coordination with the Marketing Head.
* Support LinkedIn campaigns, email marketing, lead-generation activities, and website content updates.
* Create and optimise communication for campaigns aimed at HR, L&D, and business decision-makers.
* Monitor campaign performance and suggest improvements to messaging, creatives, and targeting.
* Explore practical ways to improve engagement, conversions, and qualified enquiries.

**4. Creative Coordination & Marketing Operations**

* Work with designers, video editors, agencies, and internal teams to develop marketing assets.
* Prepare clear creative briefs and review outputs for quality and brand alignment.
* Coordinate the creation of brochures, social media creatives, videos, presentations, and other promotional materials.
* Maintain campaign trackers, content calendars, and marketing asset repositories.
* Independently follow through on assigned initiatives from planning to completion.

Skills & Competencies

**Essential**

* Excellent written English with strong copywriting and storytelling skills.
* Creative thinking and the ability to develop original marketing ideas.
* Understanding of digital marketing, content marketing, and social media communication.
* Ability to translate business objectives into audience-relevant messages.
* Strong organisational skills, initiative, and attention to detail.
* Ability to independently manage multiple activities and meet deadlines.
* Familiarity with LinkedIn marketing, Canva, and AI-assisted content creation tools.
* Basic understanding of campaign performance metrics and lead generation.

**Preferred**

* Experience in B2B marketing, preferably in HRTech, EdTech, SaaS, consulting, or professional services.
* Experience with email marketing platforms such as Mailchimp.
* Familiarity with LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Analytics, SEO, and CRM tools.
* Experience developing marketing collateral, product campaigns, and lead-generation content.
* Basic video scripting and content production skills.

Educational Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mass Communication, Journalism, Advertising, Marketing.

Relevant experience, creativity, communication ability, and quality of past work will be valued more than the specific degree.

What We're Looking For

Someone who:

* Doesn't just wait for instructions but proactively brings ideas to the table.
* Can understand a product, identify why it matters to customers, and communicate its value.
* Can think beyond routine social media posts to create meaningful and creative marketing campaigns.
* Takes ownership of execution, follows through, and delivers on commitments.
* Is curious, resourceful, commercially aware, and comfortable experimenting with new approaches.

What Success Looks Like

* Consistent and timely execution of planned marketing campaigns.
* Fresh and relevant campaign ideas aligned with product objectives.
* High-quality marketing communication across channels.
* Improved audience engagement and qualified lead-generation performance.
* Strong coordination and independent ownership of marketing deliverables.

title: Head of Product Business Unit
description:
**About Us**
**HEAD OF PRODUCT BUSINESS UNIT**
Anchanto | Pune, India | Reports to the Chief Executive Officer | Unit of 12 to 45 people
  
  
**About Anchanto**
Anchanto is an e-commerce and supply chain technology company headquartered in Singapore, with offices in twelve countries across Asia Pacific, the Middle East and Europe and its largest engineering center in Pune. Brands, retailers and logistics service providers use our purpose built SaaS products to run and scale their e-commerce and omnichannel operations: Order Management, Warehouse Management, Anchanto Grid with more than 200 ready integrations to marketplaces, carriers and enterprise systems, Parcel Tracking, Control Tower and Operations Experience, with Vantage AI as the data and insights layer across all of them. Our AI enabled agentic services, launching soon, help customers run their commerce operations with less manual work and faster decisions. More than 360 enterprise customers, including L'OrÃ©al, Panasonic, EstÃ©e Lauder, DKSH, Toll and Bosch, process over 200 million orders a year through Anchanto across more than 700 warehouses. Anchanto is an Asendia portfolio company.
  
  
**THE ROLE**
A Product Business Unit (PBU) is Product Management and Engineering for one product, brought together as a single threaded organization with one head, one backlog and one set of priorities. The head owns the product's market position, strategy, roadmap, engineering, quality, reliability and business results, and leads the engineers who build it. This is how the leading software companies are organized today: Amazon's single threaded leaders and two pizza teams, the autonomous product units at Spotify and Atlassian, the product clouds at Salesforce and Adobe each run as a business. It removes the handoffs, competing priorities and diffused accountability of separate product and engineering functions, and puts one leader in charge who decides and answers for the result.
  
  
This is not a pure product management role. You lead the engineering team as well as the product team, you own the technical quality of what ships, and you are measured on outcomes, not activities. It is the role of building a product business that leads its category: you set where the product goes, build it with your own engineering team, put it in front of the market with the revenue teams, and answer for what it earns and how customers experience it.
  
  
**WHAT YOU OWN: PRODUCT STRATEGY, ROADMAP, ENGINEERING, DECISIONS AND RESULTS**

* Product strategy. You know your market and competitors better than anyone in the company, set the product strategy and the positioning ambition with the industry research leaders, keep the product's gaps against the Gartner, Forrester and IDC criteria on your roadmap with dates, and give the CROs your input on pricing and packaging.
* Roadmap and priorities. One backlog covering the roadmap, customer commitments, innovation and tech debt, with the trade offs made by you within the portfolio allocation the CEO sets. Customer priorities and asks come to you from the Delivery team, your internal customer; you deliver against them and do not overwrite them.
* Decisions. What gets built, in what order and how; technical design within the architecture and security standards the CTO sets; release decisions; and whether your product can meet a scope and a date. No scope or date is committed on your product without your confirmation, and once committed you deliver it.
* The way we build. Specs based, AI assisted engineering is the standard way of working in every unit. You own the spec standard for your product and the readiness gate that stops work starting before decisions, credentials and test windows are in place. Quality is owned by the people who build.
* Results. Product P&L, growth, margin and contribution; reliability, incident response and customer satisfaction for your product; and the people: unit structure, hiring, promotions and a standing innovation and AI sub pod that explores adjacent capabilities.
* Ecosystem. Alignment with the other PBUs on the shared roadmap, the blueprint and joint commitments, and working in step with Product Marketing.

**COMMERCIAL INVOLVEMENT**
This is not a sales role and carries no quota. The CROs set market priorities, the go to market and what and how your product is sold; the revenue teams (existing customers, Global Strategic Accounts, Key Account Management) own the customer connect. You help them sell: you step into strategic, complex or at risk deals when asked, and you are the final word on what your product can commit to and when. You do not override or bypass them to reach customers directly.
  
  
**How You Manage Your People**

* Every person in the unit has written objectives and two or three KPIs for the quarter, reviewed monthly; nobody is without them thirty days after joining.
* Feedback is direct, factual and given within the week, in writing when it matters.
* You represent the company to your team, not the team to the company. Management debt, wrong decisions, undelivered feedback and unaddressed interpersonal issues, is fixed within thirty days of knowing about it.
* Performance is measured against objectives, not effort or tenure. An underperformer gets a written plan and a date; if it passes you take the decision yourself, including exit. Interns are confirmed and people are promoted only after a documented assessment and a direct conversation.
* The unit reports in numbers, weekly in writing and monthly in the outcome review.
* You talk to your N-1, your N-2 and every individual contributor, with skip level one to ones at least quarterly; you do the final interview of every person joining the unit; and the unit runs on a written meeting cadence you publish in your first thirty days and keep.

**OWNING CUSTOMER ESCALATIONS**
An escalation on your product is yours from the moment it is raised until the customer confirms it is closed. You do not trivialize it, and you do not expect the CEO or the CROs to lead it. You own the fix and the communication: first written update within the hour, a fixed written cadence until closed, root cause and corrective action within five working days after. You put proactive monitoring in place so the unit knows before the customer does.
  
  
**Who Decides What**

* Decision: Roadmap, prioritization, trade offs, what gets built and how, technical design within architecture guardrails, release decisions within standards.

Decides: You
  
  

* Decision: Whether your product can meet a scope and a date; unit structure, hiring and promotions within policy; spend within the approved budget.

Decides: You
  
  

* Decision: Customer priority, customer asks, revenue delivery and the external customer commitment and timeline.

Decides: Delivery, with your confirmation on scope and date
  
  

* Decision: Pricing and packaging; market priorities; go to market; what and how your product is sold; customer connect.

Decides: CROs and revenue teams, with your input on pricing
  
  

* Decision: Portfolio allocation, the blueprint, headcount and total investment, cross PBU priority collisions.

Decides: CEO
  
  

* Decision: Technology standards, security and compliance, architecture guardrails, CICD, infrastructure, data and AI platform.

Decides: CTO
  
  
**How You Are Measured**
You own outcomes, not activities. Story points, releases and features shipped are not on this scorecard. You are judged on the outputs below, and you run the unit on five to eight controllable input metrics that you propose, prove move the outputs, and review every week. Numbers are baselined in your first month and verified by Finance.
  
  

* Product led revenue enablement

What we look at: Adoption and usage depth of the modules we sell, share of customers on the current version, deals unblocked or lost on product capability, referenceable customers, time to go live
  
  

* Retention and unit margin

What we look at: Net revenue retention for your product, churn and its reasons, and the unit's contribution margin after people, infrastructure and delivery cost
  
  

* Reliability and customer satisfaction

What we look at: Availability, incidents and time to resolve, escaped defects, escalations by count, root cause and time to close, NPS or CSAT, and whether the unit found the problem before the customer did
  
  

* Planned versus actual

What we look at: Execution against the quarterly plan and the annual plan: objectives met, committed deliveries on date, say to do ratio, and variances explained in writing
  
  

* Market position

What we look at: Where the product stands against the Forrester Wave, Gartner Magic Quadrant and IDC MarketScape criteria for its category, gaps closed each quarter, and analyst recognition over time
  
  

* AI leverage and AI first approach

What we look at: Share of work built specs based and AI assisted, automation percentage by activity, cost and cycle time per delivered item falling every quarter, new work designed AI first
  
  

* Team EPS and health

What we look at: Team EPS score, attrition and regretted attrition, skills coverage, and whether the unit runs without you in the room
  
  
**PLANNING AND CADENCE**
You write the multi year product plan, the annual plan each October as a six page narrative with targets and resource scenarios, and, four weeks before each quarter, a ninety day plan derived from both, presented to and aligned with the leadership team; execution is measured against it. Weekly unit review on the inputs in writing, monthly outcome review with the CEO, quarterly review on the two or three CEO goals for your unit.
  
  
**Skills And Prior Experience**
Must haves for every candidate. Candidates without all of these will not be shortlisted.
  
  

* At least fifteen years of industry experience, with at least five of them running a product, product line, business unit or operation with accountability for its results.
* Global experience. Has worked in, and built or run operations outside India, with customers or teams in more than one country. India only experience does not qualify.
* Education. Engineering from IIT or NIT, or an MBA from IIM or a top ranked global business school.
* Domain. Commerce, logistics, supply chain or marketplace software, or the operations they serve, with enterprise customers.
* Decides and manages directly. Makes the call quickly, takes the trade off and answers for the outcome. Has set objectives for every person, given hard feedback in time, taken exit decisions personally and owned the communication in a customer crisis. Comfortable making AI assisted, specs driven engineering the default way of working.

Career paths we are open to. The role needs product, technology and business skills together; nobody arrives with all three at the same depth, so we hire from four paths and test for the second skill in each.
  
  

* Technology leader with product skills. Director of Engineering, CTO, CIO or equivalent, with deep experience in building, releasing and commercializing software systems, who has also owned a roadmap, met the market and made product trade offs, not only delivered what product handed over.
* Product management leader with technology depth. Head of Product Management or commercial product management in B2B SaaS, with technology skills to a good extent: has led or closely directed engineering teams, can hold an architecture review, and has shipped and commercialized what they defined.
* Operations practitioner from a large 3PL, retailer or brand. Has run e-commerce, fulfilment or supply chain operations as a business at scale, with deep domain knowledge of how the work is actually done, and has specified, bought or built the systems behind it well enough to direct a product team.
* Consultant or transformation leader. Head of consulting, transformation or a consulting practice in commerce or supply chain, with deep consulting and domain expertise, who has delivered systems and operating models for clients end to end rather than advised from the side.

In every path the second skill must be shown with specific examples. This role is not a Head of Engineering with a product manager reporting in, a delivery manager promoted up, a product leader who hands execution to someone else, a second sales channel to the customer, or a union leader for the team. Compensation: fixed salary, variable pay tied to the scorecard, and long term incentives; details shared with shortlisted candidates.
  
  
**Benefits**

* Global Exposure: Work with diverse teams, customers and stakeholders across international markets and gain experience in a global B2B SaaS environment.
* Learning & Development: We invest in our people through sponsored learning, certifications and development opportunities aligned with your professional growth.
* International & Onsite Opportunities: Client-facing roles may offer opportunities to travel and work onsite with customers across our global markets.
* Medical Insurance: Comprehensive medical insurance coverage to support to you and your family health and well-being.
* Comprehensive Leave Benefits: Maternity, Paternity, Marriage and Bereavement leave, along with Comp Off and flexibility to support important personal commitments.
* Recognition for Long-Term Contribution: Tenured employees are eligible for additional monetary benefits, extra paid leave and company-sponsored paid vacations as part of our commitment to recognising long-term contribution.
* Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: A supportive and flexible work environment that enables employees to manage professional responsibilities alongside personal priorities.
* Meaningful Career Growth: Take ownership of challenging, high-impact work and contribute to products and solutions that serve global brands, retailers and logistics businesses.

title: Sales And Marketing Intern
description:
Sciverse is an AI-first technology company working across healthcare technology, medical diagnostics, artificial intelligence, software development, and next-generation digital products.

We build innovative products and help businesses turn complex ideas into practical technology solutions. As we expand our customer base in India and international markets, we are looking for an ambitious Sales Intern who can help us identify opportunities, connect with potential customers, and convert conversations into business.

Who are we looking for? We are not looking for someone who simply wants to learn sales theory.
**We want someone who loves communicating, enjoys convincing people, takes initiative, and has the confidence to sell a valuable solution to the right customer.**

**You should be curious, commercially minded, articulate, persistent, and comfortable speaking with founders, business owners, senior executives, and international clients.**

**You do not need to be an expert in every product we sell. You do need the ability to understand a product quickly, identify why a customer might need it, communicate its value clearly, and make a compelling case for buying it.**

Key Responsibilities

* Identify and research potential customers, companies, and business opportunities in India and international markets.
* Generate qualified sales leads through LinkedIn, email outreach, networking, online research, and other channels.
* Initiate conversations with founders, CXOs, business owners, and decision-makers.
* Communicate Sciverse's products and services clearly, confidently, and professionally.
* Understand customer requirements, identify business problems, and position the right solution.
* Conduct initial sales conversations, schedule meetings, follow up with prospects, and help move opportunities through the sales pipeline.
* Prepare introductory emails, proposals, presentations, and other sales materials.
* Maintain accurate lead information, follow-up schedules, and sales activity records in the CRM.
* Research new markets, identify potential business partners, and support international business development.
* Work with the founding team to develop outreach strategies, test sales approaches, and improve conversion rates.
* Take ownership of assigned leads and consistently work toward measurable sales targets.

Essential Requirements

**1. Excellent English communication — mandatory**

**You must have very strong spoken and written English. You should be able to write professional business emails, hold confident conversations, explain ideas clearly, and communicate with international customers without constant assistance.**

**2. Confidence and persuasion**

**You should be comfortable initiating conversations with strangers, handling objections, asking relevant questions, negotiating professionally, and asking for the next step or the sale.**

**3. A genuine interest in selling**

**We value people who enjoy understanding customer needs, creating opportunities, persuading thoughtfully, and closing deals. A willingness to make calls, hear “no,” learn from rejection, and follow up consistently is essential.**

**4. Smart, proactive, and commercially aware**

**You should be able to research a company, understand what it does, identify a potential need, and explain why Sciverse could be relevant to that business.**

**5. Ownership and execution**

**We expect initiative, consistency, accountability, and a results-oriented approach. You should be able to work independently while collaborating closely with the founding team.**

**6. Comfortable with technology**

**You should be willing to learn about AI, software products, digital platforms, healthcare technology, and business solutions well enough to communicate their value to potential customers.**

Languages: A Strong Advantage

Excellent English is compulsory. Knowledge of any additional language that can help us engage customers across international markets will be a significant advantage.

Particularly useful languages include:

* **German**
  — Germany, Austria, Switzerland, and other European markets.
* **French**
  — France, parts of Europe, Canada, and French-speaking African markets.
* **Spanish**
  — Spain and Latin American markets.
* **Arabic**
  — Middle Eastern markets.
* **Japanese**
  — Japan.
* **Mandarin Chinese**
  — China and Chinese-speaking business networks.
* **Portuguese**
  — Brazil and Portugal.
* **Other languages**
  are welcome if you can demonstrate how they could help us expand into new markets.

Language proficiency must be genuine and useful for business communication. An additional language is a bonus, not a replacement for excellent English.

What You Will Gain

* Direct exposure to business development and international B2B sales.
* Opportunities to interact with founders, executives, and decision-makers.
* Practical experience selling AI, software, healthcare technology, and digital solutions.
* Experience in lead generation, prospecting, sales strategy, negotiation, and pipeline management.
* The opportunity to take ownership of real business opportunities and contribute directly to company growth.
* A fast-learning environment where initiative, performance, and measurable results matter.

Who Should Apply?

Students, recent graduates, and aspiring sales professionals who are confident communicators, curious about technology, and motivated to build a career in sales, business development, or international business.

Prior sales experience is an advantage, but it is not mandatory. We are interested in your communication skills, attitude, initiative, ability to learn, and willingness to deliver results.

**At Sciverse, we value people who can turn conversations into opportunities and opportunities into business. If you are confident, curious, persuasive, and ready to learn by doing, we would love to hear from you.**

Position Name: Performance Marketing Expert – Google Ads

Configures, localizes and operates global MarTech platforms for segment-specific campaign execution and consumer engagement to meet the segment's commercial and marketing objectives

* Understanding of how global MarTech platforms are configured and operated at segment level to enable end-to-end marketing execution
* Ability to operate in a matrixed structure, balancing segment-specific commercial priorities with enterprise platform standards
* Familiarity with segment market regulatory and data privacy requirements that shape how marketing technology is operated in the region
* Financial fluency in P&L dynamics, business case development, and OKR/KPIs

**Key Measure of Success**

* Campaign technology readiness — % of planned segment marketing campaigns technically enabled on schedule against the segment marketing calendar
* Segment demand fulfillment — % of segment marketing technology requests delivered against committed intake within agreed timeframes

description:

We need someone who takes ownership of marketing campaigns, understands performance metrics, tests new ideas, and continuously works to improve lead quality and campaign results.

Candidates with practical experience and demonstrable campaign performance will be preferred.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates can apply with their updated resume and relevant digital marketing experience. Please include examples of campaigns managed and measurable results, wherever available.

**Location:**
Pune, Maharashtra, India

Join Mahir Invest and contribute to our growth through effective, performance-driven digital marketing.

title: Growth Executive Performance marketing
description:
D2C Growth & Performance Marketing Executive

**Location:**
Pune (Hadapsar)

**Salary:**
₹5–10 LPA

**Experience:**
2+ years

**Work Mode:**
Onsite

**Work Timings:**
9:30 AM – 6:30 PM | Alternate Saturdays off

About FarmDidi

FarmDidi is a funded foodtech startup on a mission to empower 1 million+ rural women while bringing high-quality, authentic food products to Indian households.

We are building India's next Amul — rooted in purpose, driven by data, and built with relentless execution.

* #1 Pickle Brand on Amazon India
* Featured on Shark Tank India
* Backed by Samved VC, LetsVenture, Indigram Labs and IIM Calcutta
* Recognised by UNDP, NITI Aayog, Wharton Economic Forum, Maharashtra Government and MEITY

We are a small, ambitious team where every person has real ownership and directly contributes to building the company.

About the Role

We are looking for a
**D2C Growth & Performance Marketing Executive**
who can own the complete P&L of our D2C business.

This is not just a performance marketing role.

You will own the commercial performance of the D2C business — including revenue, Meta and Google advertising spends, customer acquisition, CAC, ROAS, AOV, conversion rate, contribution margin and profitability.

You should be someone who genuinely gets excited by
**Meta Ads, Google Ads, numbers and analysis**
.

You should enjoy looking at campaign data and asking:

* Why did CAC increase?
* Why did ROAS change?
* Which creative is actually driving conversions?
* Which audience is working?
* Where are customers dropping off?
* What changed from last week?
* What should we test next?
* Where is the next meaningful growth opportunity?

We are looking for someone who does not simply report numbers, but understands the story behind the numbers and converts analysis into action.

What You Will Own1. D2C P&L Ownership

Own the overall performance and profitability of the D2C business, including:

* D2C revenue
* Customer acquisition
* Marketing spends
* CAC
* ROAS
* AOV
* Conversion rate
* Repeat purchases
* Contribution margin
* Overall D2C profitability

You will work closely with the Founders to set monthly and quarterly revenue and profitability targets.

You will not just report numbers.

**You will own the numbers.**

2. Meta and Google Ads

You will be the primary owner of FarmDidi's Meta and Google advertising engine.

Responsibilities include:

* Own Meta and Google advertising budgets
* Plan and allocate monthly and weekly spends
* Build, manage and optimize campaigns
* Scale winning campaigns
* Identify and fix underperforming campaigns
* Manage CAC and ROAS
* Test audiences, creatives, keywords, placements and campaign structures
* Monitor CPM, CPC, CTR, CVR, CAC and ROAS
* Forecast advertising spends and revenue
* Build performance dashboards and reports
* Identify new opportunities for growth
* Continuously experiment with new campaign formats, tools and strategies

**Hands-on experience managing Meta and Google Ads spends is mandatory.**

We are not looking for someone who has only executed campaigns under supervision. We want someone who has genuinely owned budgets and performance.

3. Analytics and Growth

We are looking for someone who is
**highly analytical and genuinely enjoys analysis.**

You should enjoy spending time with campaign, customer and business data to identify patterns, problems and opportunities.

You should naturally ask:

* Why did CAC increase?
* Why did ROAS drop?
* Which creative is winning and why?
* Which audience is converting?
* Which products are driving profitable growth?
* Where are customers dropping off?
* What changed compared to last week or last month?
* What does the data tell us that we are currently missing?
* What should we test next?

Your role is not simply to present data.

Your role is to turn:

**Data → Insight → Hypothesis → Experiment → Learning → Scale**

4. Content and Creative Strategy

Work closely with the content, creative and brand teams to build content that drives business outcomes.

You will:

* Analyse creative performance
* Identify winning creative themes
* Identify winning hooks and messaging
* Develop creative briefs
* Build a continuous creative testing pipeline
* Identify content opportunities based on customer and campaign data
* Translate performance insights into actionable content requirements
* Work with designers, content creators and video teams

You should be able to look at performance data and tell the content team:

**"This is what is working. This is what is not working. Let's create and test multiple variations."**

5. SEO and Organic Growth

Work closely with the SEO and content teams to build sustainable organic acquisition.

You will:

* Identify high-intent search opportunities
* Use Google Ads search data to inform SEO strategy
* Identify content gaps and opportunities
* Improve organic acquisition
* Analyse paid vs organic acquisition
* Identify opportunities to reduce long-term dependency on paid acquisition

6. Shopify and CRO

Work closely with our Shopify developers to improve the D2C funnel.

You will identify and prioritize:

* Landing page improvements
* Product page improvements
* Checkout improvements
* Conversion tracking issues
* Pixel and analytics issues
* Page speed improvements
* Funnel drop-offs
* CRO opportunities
* A/B testing opportunities

You don't need to be a developer.

But you should be able to clearly communicate:

**What is the problem? Why does it matter commercially? What should we fix or test?**

7. Team Management

You will work with and eventually manage members of the growth and performance marketing team.

You should be comfortable with:

* Setting goals
* Delegating responsibilities
* Reviewing performance
* Coaching team members
* Building SOPs
* Creating accountability
* Hiring and training talent
* Building a culture of experimentation and performance

Prior experience managing or mentoring a team is strongly preferred.

What We Are Looking ForMust Have

* 2+ years of experience in Performance Marketing, Growth Marketing or D2C
* Strong hands-on experience with Meta Ads
* Strong hands-on experience with Google Ads
* Experience managing meaningful advertising budgets
* Experience in D2C, e-commerce, FMCG, consumer brands or startups
* Strong understanding of CAC, ROAS, CPM, CPC, CTR, CVR, AOV, LTV and contribution margin
* Highly analytical mindset
* Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills
* Experience with GA4 and conversion tracking
* Experience working with Shopify or another e-commerce platform
* Experience managing or mentoring a team
* Strong communication and problem-solving skills

Good to Have

* Experience owning a D2C P&L
* Experience managing ₹10L+ monthly advertising spends
* Experience scaling a consumer brand
* Experience in FMCG, food or consumer products
* SEO / organic growth experience
* CRO and landing page optimization experience
* Experience working closely with content and creative teams
* Experience with Amazon Ads or other digital advertising platforms

The Person We Are Looking For

You should be:

**Highly analytical**

Numbers should excite you. You enjoy digging into dashboards, spreadsheets and campaign data to find patterns, anomalies and opportunities.

**Curious**

You don't simply accept that performance changed. You want to understand why.

**Commercially minded**

You understand that revenue without healthy contribution margins is not sustainable growth.

**Hands-on**

You are comfortable getting into Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads yourself.

**Experiment-driven**

You form hypotheses, test quickly, analyse the results and scale what works.

**Detail-oriented**

You notice when a metric moves unexpectedly and investigate it.

**Ownership-driven**

You don't wait for someone to tell you what to do. You identify problems and take responsibility for solving them.

**Fast-moving**

You believe insights should quickly become experiments and experiments should quickly generate learning.

**Collaborative**

You can work effectively with Founders, content, creative, SEO, Shopify developers and other teams.

**A team leader**

You can manage, coach and develop people while maintaining high standards.

**Always learning**

You actively follow the latest developments in Meta, Google, AI, D2C, CRO and performance marketing.

Most importantly, you should genuinely
**enjoy Meta Ads, Google Ads, numbers and analysis.**

If finding a new creative angle, identifying why CAC moved, improving ROAS or discovering a new growth lever genuinely excites you, you will enjoy this role.

How We Will Measure Success

Your success will be measured by business outcomes, not by the number of campaigns launched.

You will be accountable for:

* D2C Revenue Growth
* CAC
* ROAS
* Contribution Margin
* New Customer Acquisition
* AOV
* Conversion Rate
* Repeat Purchase Rate
* Organic Revenue Growth
* D2C Profitability

The goal is to build a scalable and increasingly profitable D2C growth engine for FarmDidi.

Why Join FarmDidi?

* Work directly with the Founders
* Real ownership from Day 1
* Own a meaningful business P&L
* Build the growth engine of a rapidly growing consumer brand
* Work across Performance Marketing, Content, SEO, Shopify, CRO and Business Strategy
* 6-month appraisals
* ESOP opportunity
* High autonomy and fast decision-making
* Build a business that creates livelihoods for rural women

You won't just be running ads.

**You will be building a business.**

If this sounds like you, we would love to hear from you.

title: Manager, Product Management
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Manager, Product Management
  
  
**Overview**
Mastercard Merchant Cloud and Acceptance represent core strategic priorities for the Asia Pacific region. Our mission is to empower acquirers, merchants, payment service providers (PSPs), and payment facilitators by delivering seamless, best-in-class experiences across both digital and in-person commerce. We aim to position Mastercard Merchant Cloud as the leading platform for acceptance.
  
  
As an integral part of Mastercard’s regional growth strategy, this role will support sales initiatives across Asia Pacific. Key responsibilities include conducting market research and benchmarking, contributing to go-to-market planning, supporting solution commercialization, and engaging in client-related activities. The individual will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams—including Product, Operations, Delivery, Compliance, Legal, Marketing, and other internal partners—to drive execution and deliver strategic outcomes.
  
  
Role
  
  

* Support the identification and assessment of potential opportunities for Merchant Cloud across APAC through data analysis and insight generation.
* Conduct customer segmentation and lifecycle analysis to identify indicators of expansion, cross-sell, or product adoption potential
* Analyze transaction characteristics and market data to support identification of relevant customer segments
* Develop and maintain analytical frameworks and reporting models including opportunity sizing approaches, funnel and conversion analytics, and pipeline coverage metrics for internal monitoring and decision-support purposes.
* Build and maintain integrated analytical datasets and internal insight packs by combining data sources for internal analysis.
* Integrate diverse data inputs to generate analytical insights and structured outputs that may indicate high-potential customers segments and support internal prioritization discussions.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to provide analytical support and validate data assumptions; does not involve participation in commercial decision-making or execution.
* Provide data backed insights, benchmarking and analytical inputs to support value propositions by relevant team, ensuring Mastercard’s differentiation in the Merchant Cloud and Acceptance space.
* Analyse client trends and develop reports and dashboards to provide visibility and support internal decision-making and performance monitoring.
* Partner with internal technology and core payments teams to support pipeline generation through various data sources, reporting and opportunity sizing models.

**All About You**

* Experience in payments, fintech, or e-commerce in APAC, ideally with exposure to acquirers, PSPs, merchants, or acceptance ecosystems.
* Strong data analysis capability, including advanced Excel (mandatory) and Tableau or Power BI (preferred).
* Proven ability to work with multi-source datasets and synthesize them into clear, practical outputs.
* Experience supporting multi-market proposition launches, including pipeline dashboards, account-level analysis, and business insights that inform commercial decision-making.
* Ability to translate data into simple, compelling narratives for non-technical stakeholders.
* High ownership mindset, self-starter mentality, and strong problem-solving skills.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with a bias for action and the ability to create structure within a matrix organization.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.
