title: Digital Marketing Associate
description:
**AskTalos (Nevis Software Solutions Pvt. Ltd.)**

**Location:**
Remote (India)

**Type:**
Full-time

**Experience**
: 2 to 4 years

**Salary**
: ₹4.2 – ₹5.4 LPA (fixed in hand)

**Working days:**
Monday to Saturday, 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM

**Notice period:**
30 days or less (immediate joiners preferred)

**About AskTalos**

AskTalos is an AI-powered customer communication and sales automation platform for Indian SMBs. It brings AI voice calling, WhatsApp Business API, AI CRM and email automation into one place. We help business owners respond to every lead instantly, follow up automatically and close more sales without adding headcount.

We’re a fast-growing SaaS startup. This is a
**solo, high-ownership role reporting directly to the CEO**
. You won’t be “supporting marketing.” You’ll be running it.

**Your mission**

Turn marketing spend and content into
**booked product demos**
, and build an
**organic traffic engine**
that brings in leads every month.

**What you’ll own**

**1. Paid campaigns on Meta, Google and LinkedIn (main focus)**

* Plan, launch and manage lead-generation campaigns end to end: audience, creative, copy, budget and bidding.
* Run weekly A/B tests on hooks, creatives, audiences and landing pages.
* Optimise for demos booked and lead quality, not just clicks and impressions.
* Manage the monthly ad budget responsibly, with full visibility on spend versus results.

**2. Creatives and reels**

* Design ad creatives, carousels and social posts in Canva.
* Edit short-form reels and video ads in CapCut.
* Turn product features into scroll-stopping content that SMB owners understand.

**3. Website and landing pages**

* Build and improve landing pages for campaigns.
* Keep the website updated, fast and conversion-focused.

**4. SEO**

* Do keyword research for high-intent SaaS and SMB searches.
* Handle on-page SEO, technical health checks and content briefs for blogs and pages.
* Grow organic traffic and inbound demo requests month on month.

**5. Social media**

* Own the content calendar for Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook and YouTube.
* Build an audience of SMB owners with educational and trust-building content.

**6. Email and WhatsApp campaigns (supporting role)**

* Plan and run campaigns on our own automation platform, writing the copy, segments and offers.

**7. Analytics and reporting**

* Own tracking through GA4, Meta Pixel and Conversions API, UTMs and Search Console.
* Send a weekly report to the CEO covering demos booked, cost per demo, organic traffic, what worked and what’s next.

**How success is measured**

* Number of demos booked from marketing.
* Cost per demo and lead quality.
* Organic traffic growth.
* Efficient use of the monthly ad budget.

**Must-haves**

* At least 2 years of hands-on digital marketing, with campaigns you ran yourself.
* Proven lead-gen results on Meta and Google Ads. LinkedIn Ads experience is a strong plus.
* Working knowledge of Meta Business Manager, GA4, Google Search Console, and SEMrush or Ahrefs.
* Ability to design in Canva and edit reels in CapCut.
* Ability to build or edit landing pages and website content.
* A data-first mindset: you can explain
  *why*
  a campaign worked or failed.
* Self-driven and comfortable working alone and remotely, with clear communication and ownership.

**Preferred**

* Experience in B2B or SaaS marketing.
* Experience with WhatsApp or email marketing campaigns.
* Comfort using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) to move faster.
* Ability to write content in Hindi as well as English.

**What we expect in your first 90 days**

* **First 30 days:**
  Audit current campaigns, SEO, social media and tracking, and fix the gaps.
* **By day 60:**
  Run your own campaigns on Meta, Google and LinkedIn, with a measurable improvement in cost per demo.
* **By day 90:**
  Run a predictable monthly demo-booking engine and show organic traffic trending upward.

**Why join AskTalos**

* **Full ownership.**
  You report directly to the CEO, and your ideas go live in days, not months.
* **Fully remote.**
  Work from anywhere in India.
* **Fast learning.**
  You’ll market an AI product in one of India’s fastest-growing SaaS spaces.
* **Real impact.**
  Your work directly drives company revenue.

title: EY - GDS Consulting -AI Strategy & Go-To-Market
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**JOB DESCRIPTION | AI & DATA TECH CONSULTING**
**AI Strategy & Go-To-Market**
Career Family: AIA – AI Strategy & GTM
  
  

* Pursuits, RFPs & Offering Development

**LEVEL**
**Senior/Manager**
**Experience**
**8–12 years**
**LOCATION**
EY GDS
  
  

* Hybrid

**ORIENTATION**
**Strategy-led**
THE OPPORTUNITY
  
  
We are seeking a strategic Manager to join our AI & Data Tech Consulting team, focused on shaping how clients adopt Agentic AI and GenAI — and how the firm takes its AI offerings to market. The ideal candidate brings a blend of AI product strategy, solution positioning, and pursuit leadership, with enough technical fluency to credibly translate AI capabilities into business value, without being a hands-on builder.
  
  
You will work closely with account leaders, solution architects, C-suite stakeholders, and alliance partners to win and shape AI programs — owning the narrative from opportunity qualification and RFP response through solution storyboarding, commercial framing, and client orals.
  
  
**WHERE YOUR TIME GOES**
**40%**
**RFPs, Proposals & Pursuits**
Win themes, solution storyline, client orals
  
  
**30%**
**Go-To-Market & Offerings**
Positioning, enablement collateral, alliances
  
  
**30%**
**AI Strategy & Advisory**
Roadmaps, business cases, operating models
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
AI Strategy & Value Advisory
  
  
■ Partner with client leadership and Operating Partners to define AI / Agentic AI vision, use-case portfolios, and adoption roadmaps.
  
  
■ Build use-case prioritization frameworks (value vs. feasibility vs. risk) and translate them into phased roadmaps (discovery → MVP → scale).
  
  
■ Develop business cases with ROI, cost-to-serve, and value-realization metrics that leadership can fund against.
  
  
■ Frame AI operating models — CoE design, governance, Responsible AI guardrails, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  
  
■ Knowledge of business process transformation and industry value chains (Health, FS, Consumer, Industrials) would be an added advantage.
  
  
Go-To-Market & Offering Development
  
  
■ Shape and package AI offerings, accelerators, and assets into market-ready propositions — positioning, messaging, pricing logic, and differentiation.
  
  
■ Build sales enablement collateral: pitch decks, solution one-pagers, executive pagers, demo storylines, case studies, and battle cards.
  
  
■ Conduct market, competitive, and analyst research (vendors, hyperscalers, AI-native startups) to inform build / buy / partner decisions and offering roadmaps.
  
  
■ Work with alliance partners (Microsoft, AWS, Google, ServiceNow, Salesforce, etc.) on joint GTM motions, co-sell plays, and partner-funded programs.
  
  
■ Track adoption and pipeline KPIs for offerings and feed market signals back into the offering roadmap.
  
  
RFPs, Proposals & Pursuits
  
  
■ Lead end-to-end RFP / RFI / RFQ responses for AI and data programs — bid / no-bid qualification, win themes, solution storyline, and response orchestration.
  
  
■ Translate client requirements into a crisp solution narrative, scope, delivery approach, staffing model, and commercial construct, in collaboration with architects and delivery leads.
  
  
■ Own proposal quality — compliance matrices, executive summaries, value articulation, risk and assumption logs.
  
  
■ Prepare and lead client orals, executive workshops, and proof-of-value storyboards; coach pursuit teams on messaging.
  
  
■ Maintain a reusable pursuit library of proposal content, case studies, and credentials.
  
  
AI Fluency (Conversational, Not Hands-On)
  
  
■ Working understanding of LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI frameworks, AI evaluation & observability, and LLMOps — enough to engage architects and challenge solutions credibly.
  
  
■ Awareness of AI risk, regulation, and governance (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001) and how they shape client buying decisions.
  
  
■ Familiarity with cloud AI platforms (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI) and enterprise data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake) at a solution level.
  
  
■ Comfort with AI productivity tools to accelerate research, content, and proposal creation.
  
  
Business Development & Client Management
  
  
■ Work closely with account leaders to identify, qualify, and shape opportunities and build tailored value propositions for strategic accounts.
  
  
■ Build trusted relationships with client CXOs, product owners, and transformation leaders.
  
  
■ Represent the firm at analyst briefings, industry forums, webinars, and thought-leadership platforms; author POVs, whitepapers, and blogs.
  
  
Team Leadership & Collaboration
  
  
■ Lead and mentor a small team of strategy consultants and pursuit analysts.
  
  
■ Orchestrate collaboration across solution architects, delivery, sector specialists, alliances, legal, and pricing teams.
  
  
■ Drive knowledge sharing, offering playbooks, and capability-building across the practice.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes**
Educational Background
  
  
■ MBA / PGDM in Strategy, Marketing, or Business Management from a premier institute. Engineering or quantitative undergraduate background preferred.
  
  
Professional Experience
  
  
■ 8–12 years of experience across AI / data product management, strategy consulting, solution / pre-sales, or GTM roles.
  
  
■ Proven track record of shaping and winning AI, GenAI, or data-driven transformation deals, or of taking AI products from strategy to launch and adoption.
  
  
■ Experience building offerings, roadmaps, business cases, and executive-facing collateral for enterprise clients.
  
  
■ Exposure to market research, competitive benchmarking, startup / vendor evaluation, or innovation programs is a strong plus.
  
  
Soft Skills
  
  
■ Exceptional storytelling and executive presence — able to turn complex AI concepts into a compelling, simple business narrative.
  
  
■ Strong structured thinking and problem-solving; comfortable working under pursuit deadlines.
  
  
■ Excellent written communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, especially with C-suite executives.
  
  
■ Influencing without authority across large, matrixed pursuit teams.
  
  
**Preferred Certifications**
■ GenAI / AI strategy certifications (Microsoft, AWS, Google, Coursera, ISB / IIM executive programs, etc.)
  
  
■ Product management or agile certifications (SAFe POPM / PM, Pragmatic, CSPO), Design Thinking.
  
  
■ APMP (proposal management) certification is a plus.
  
  
IDEAL PROFILE
  
  
**You will thrive here if you…**
■ Have taken AI / data products from 0 → 1 and know what drives adoption
  
  
■ Love building the story, the business case, and the winning proposal
  
  
■ Can hold your own with architects — and simplify for the CXO
  
  
■ Have run market scans, vendor evaluations, or innovation programs
  
  
**This role is not…**
■ A hands-on engineering or model-building role
  
  
■ Writing production code, data pipelines, or agent frameworks
  
  
■ Pure delivery / project management
  
  
■ A back-office bid-desk formatting role
  
  
WHY JOIN US
  
  
■ Shape how leading global enterprises adopt AI — and how the firm wins in the AI market.
  
  
■ Work at the intersection of strategy, technology, and growth, with direct visibility to account and practice leadership.
  
  
■ Collaborate with a team of AI experts, solution architects, and industry specialists in a highly entrepreneurial environment.
  
  
**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  
■
**Continuous learning**
— You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
  
  
■
**Success as defined by you**
— We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
  
  
■
**Transformative leadership**
— We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
  
  
■
**Diverse and inclusive culture**
— You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Market Performance Manager
description:
At SiteMinder, we believe our success comes from our people. We build diverse, inclusive teams where different voices, backgrounds and perspectives are valued. Our differences drive innovation for our customers, and our people bring the ideas, expertise and energy that help us keep moving forward. We’re better together.
  
  
**What We Do...**
Right now, somewhere in the world, a hotel is taking a booking or increasing their revenue through technology you could help build. SiteMinder is the world’s leading hotel commerce platform. For more than 20 years, we’ve helped hotels attract guests, maximise revenue, forecast demand and perform at their best. Today, our platform supports 56,000+ hotels in 150+ countries, connects to 3,000+ partners and powers more than 140m reservations and AU$85 billion+ in hotel revenue each year.
  
  
That’s the kind of impact your work can have here. You’ll solve meaningful challenges with AI, simplify complexity and build solutions that help hotels perform. Supported by clear purpose, a strong platform and teams who care about what they’re building, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of an industry that never stands still.
  
  
**About The Market Performance Manager Role…**
The Market Performance Team Manager leads a high-performing team of Market Performance Team Leads and Specialists who optimise distribution and revenue strategy for our hotel customers. This role is accountable for building and scaling a centre of excellence in market performance — ensuring hotels maximise bookings and profitable revenue through the intelligent use of SiteMinder’s platform, channel mix, and pricing strategies.
  
  
Combining strategic leadership, deep commercial acumen and strong people management, the Market Performance Team Manager oversees pipeline and performance across all optimisation initiatives, drives capability development in revenue and distribution management, and partners closely with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver measurable uplift in customer value, retention and revenue outcomes.
  
  
**What You’ll Do…**

* Strategic Leadership: Develop and implement comprehensive market management strategies that maximise product value and drive customer ROI, with a strong focus on revenue and distribution optimisation.
* Team Development & Leadership: Lead, mentor, and develop Market Performance Team Leads and Specialists. Provide coaching, training and feedback to build deep revenue and distribution optimisation capability across the team.
* Pipeline Management: Own and manage the optimisation and revenue pipeline (initiatives, cases and opportunities), including forecasting, prioritisation and resourcing. Monitor pipeline health, conversion and velocity, and drive continuous improvements in team productivity.
* Performance Reporting: Build and maintain clear performance reporting on optimisation pipeline, revenue impact and team productivity, providing visibility to internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, to customers.
* Distribution Optimisation: Design and oversee strategies that optimise distribution mix (OTAs, direct, GDS and other channels) to drive profitable bookings for hotels. Ensure the team can diagnose channel performance issues and execute corrective actions.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Product, Engineering, Marketing and Sales to ensure market performance and optimisation needs inform product development and go-to-market strategies.
* Optimisation Program Design: Create and implement scalable optimisation programs that systematically improve customer outcomes and revenue performance across different tiers and segments.
* Performance Management: Consistently meet or exceed team KPIs. Monitor pipeline, revenue and productivity metrics, and coach Team Leads and Specialists to improve conversion, quality and impact.
* Stakeholder Management: Build strong relationships with key stakeholders across the business. Represent the market performance function in executive forums and champion customer and revenue outcomes.
* Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to enhance optimisation processes, tools and methodologies. Drive innovation in market performance and revenue optimisation delivery to maintain competitive advantage.

**What You Have…**

* Extensive experience in market management at an OTA, customer success, upgrade sales, account management, BPO or similar customer-facing roles, with good experience in a leadership position managing teams (Team Operations).
* Experience leading and developing managers (particularly Team Leads) and frontline specialists, including training and coaching on revenue and distribution optimisation best practices.
* Available to flex schedule across global hours
* Proven track record of designing and implementing successful market performance and/or optimisation programs that drive measurable revenue and customer outcomes.
* Strong analytical skills with experience using data to inform strategic decision-making, manage a pipeline and demonstrate ROI (e.g. RevPAR, ADR, occupancy, channel mix, conversion, productivity).
* Solid grounding in hotel revenue management concepts, including demand forecasting, pricing, inventory and channel management, and competitive set analysis.
* Preferable experience optimising distribution strategy and channel mix (OTAs, direct, GDS and other channels) to improve profitability and share.
* Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence at all levels of an organisation. Fluent English required; additional languages (Spanish, German, French, Italian, Thai, Vietnamese, Bahasa, Portuguese or Mandarin) are a plus.
* Strategic mindset with the ability to translate business objectives into actionable market performance and revenue optimisation plans.
* Experience in the hotel industry or travel technology sector is highly desirable; background in Market Performance Management from an OTA is highly beneficial.
* Advanced negotiation skills with the ability to train teams in contract negotiation and value-based selling.
* Proficient in Salesforce and G-Suite with ability to analyse data across Salesforce reporting, Tableau (as a reader) and Google Sheets.

**Our Perks & Benefits…**

* Mental health and well-being initiatives
* Generous parental (including secondary) leave policy
* Flexibility to work in a Hybrid model (3 days in-office)
* Paid birthday, study and volunteering leave every year
* Sponsored social clubs, team events, and celebrations
* Employee Resource Groups (ERG) to help you connect and get involved
* Investment in your personal growth offering training for your advancement

Think this role sounds like you? If so, we’d love to hear from you. Please send us your resume and our Talent Acquisition team will be in touch.
  
  
When you apply, feel free to share your pronouns and let us know if you need any adjustments during the interview process, we’re here to support you. We also warmly encourage applications from people from underrepresented backgrounds.

description:

title: Director – Performance Marketing & D2C Growth
description:
**Director – Performance Marketing & D2C Growth**

Organisation: HyperScale

Location: Koregaon Park, Pune

Work Mode: Full-time, Work from Office

Salary: ₹12–18 lakh per annum, depending on experience and capability

**Read this before you apply:**

Please apply only if you have strong, hands-on performance marketing experience and have driven measurable business outcomes across multiple D2C/eCommerce brands.

**ABOUT HYPERSCALE**

HyperScale is a business growth and mentoring ecosystem working with ambitious founders and consumer brands across India. Through our flagship Quantum Program, we work closely with approximately 100 founders and brands across categories such as beauty, skincare, wellness, fashion, food, home, jewellery and personal care.

We are looking for a highly experienced Performance Marketing and D2C Growth expert who can help our Quantum member brands improve advertising performance, lower customer acquisition costs, increase ROAS, strengthen their funnels and scale profitably.

This is not a routine media-buying role. It is a portfolio-level growth role where you will audit multiple brands, diagnose performance gaps, guide founders and their agencies, and drive measurable business outcomes.

**PRIMARY MANDATE**

Drive measurable performance improvement across approximately 100 Quantum member brands and HyperScale’s own lead-generation funnel.

You will work across multiple categories, business stages and agency setups. Your role will be to identify what is limiting growth, recommend the right strategy, review execution and ensure that founders receive clear, practical and commercially sound guidance.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

1. AUDIT QUANTUM MEMBER BRANDS

Conduct structured audits of Meta Ads, Google Ads and other relevant performance marketing channels.

Review:

• Account and campaign structure

• Customer acquisition cost

• ROAS and MER

• Conversion rate

• Average order value

• Creative performance

• Audience and targeting strategy

• Budget allocation

• Landing pages and product pages

• Funnel leakages

• Tracking and attribution

• New versus repeat customer economics

• Contribution margin and profitability

Translate the audit into a clear action plan with prioritised recommendations for the founder and their marketing team.

1. BUILD BRAND-SPECIFIC GROWTH STRATEGIES

Develop practical performance marketing strategies based on each brand’s category, customer profile, product mix, pricing, margins, current revenue, growth stage and business objectives.

Help founders answer questions such as:

• Which products should be scaled?

• Which audiences should be targeted?

• Which offers should be tested?

• What kind of creatives are required?

• How should budgets be allocated?

• Where is the funnel leaking?

• Should the brand scale, optimise, restructure or pause campaigns?

• What changes are required to improve profitability?

1. GUIDE AND REVIEW AGENCIES

Work with the respective performance marketing agencies or internal teams of Quantum member brands.

Review their strategy, challenge assumptions, identify gaps and ensure that execution is aligned with the agreed growth plan.

Help founders evaluate whether their agency is:

• Asking the right questions

• Tracking the right metrics

• Testing creatives meaningfully

• Managing budgets responsibly

• Scaling profitably

• Reporting transparently

• Taking ownership of outcomes

1. CONDUCT REGULAR PERFORMANCE REVIEWS

Create a structured review rhythm for selected Quantum member brands.

Track performance across metrics such as:

• CAC

• ROAS

• MER

• Revenue

• Orders

• Conversion rate

• Average order value

• Repeat purchase rate

• Contribution margin

• New customer revenue

• Creative success rate

• Landing-page conversion

• Funnel-stage conversion rates

Identify problems early, recommend corrective actions and follow through on implementation.

1. IMPROVE HYPERSCALE’S OWN LEAD-GENERATION FUNNEL

Own and strengthen HyperScale’s paid acquisition and lead-generation performance.

Work across:

• Meta Ads

• Google Ads

• YouTube Ads

• Landing pages

• Lead magnets

• Webinar and workshop funnels

• Retargeting

• Lead nurturing

• Conversion optimisation

The objective is to improve lead quality, reduce cost per lead, increase attendance and improve conversion into HyperScale’s programs.

1. BUILD PERFORMANCE MARKETING SYSTEMS

Create repeatable systems and frameworks that can be used across multiple brands.

This may include:

• Audit templates

• Campaign review scorecards

• Creative review frameworks

• Weekly reporting formats

• Agency evaluation systems

• Funnel diagnosis tools

• Budget allocation frameworks

• Scaling-readiness scorecards

• Corrective action plans

• D2C performance marketing playbooks

1. EDUCATE AND ENABLE FOUNDERS

Explain performance marketing concepts in a simple, commercially relevant and founder-friendly manner.

Conduct group sessions, masterclasses or review clinics for Quantum members whenever required.

Help founders understand the numbers that matter without overwhelming them with technical jargon.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Success in this role will be measured through:

• Reduction in customer acquisition costs

• Improvement in ROAS and MER

• Growth in profitable order volumes

• Improvement in conversion rates

• Better creative-testing systems

• Stronger agency accountability

• Faster diagnosis and correction of performance issues

• Improvement in founder confidence and satisfaction

• Better lead-generation economics for HyperScale

• Creation of scalable systems across the Quantum ecosystem

IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE

We are looking for someone who has:

• 7–12+ years of experience in performance marketing, digital growth or customer acquisition

• Strong hands-on experience with Meta Ads and Google Ads

• Experience handling multiple D2C or consumer brands across categories

• Experience managing meaningful advertising budgets

• Strong understanding of CAC, ROAS, MER, AOV, LTV, contribution margin and unit economics

• Ability to audit accounts and identify performance gaps quickly

• Strong understanding of creative strategy, landing pages, offers, funnels and conversion optimisation

• Experience working with founders, agencies and internal marketing teams

• Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder-management skills

• A commercial, practical and outcome-oriented mindset

• Ability to work across multiple brands with depth and accountability

Experience in a leading performance marketing agency, D2C company, consumer company, marketplace or high-growth startup will be preferred.

WHO THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR

This role may not be suitable for someone who:

• Has only executed campaigns without owning business outcomes

• Understands platform metrics but not profitability

• Has worked only on one category or one advertising platform

• Cannot challenge agencies or senior stakeholders

• Depends entirely on dashboards without understanding customer behaviour

• Is uncomfortable managing multiple brands simultaneously

• Is looking for a remote or freelance consulting engagement

**WHY JOIN HYPERSCALE?**

• Work closely with approximately 100 ambitious founders and consumer brands

• Gain exposure to multiple categories and business models

• Influence real revenue and profitability outcomes

• Build a performance marketing centre of excellence

• Work directly with HyperScale’s leadership and founder ecosystem

• Create frameworks that support the growth of Indian consumer brands

• Contribute to HyperScale’s mission of making India the Brand Capital of the World

**APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS**

Please apply with:

• Updated CV

• Details of brands and categories handled

• Approximate monthly advertising budgets managed

• Two or three examples of measurable performance improvement

• Examples of how you reduced CAC, improved ROAS or increased profitability

• Current compensation

• Expected compensation

• Notice period

• Confirmation of willingness to work full-time from Koregaon Park, Pune

**Please apply only if you have strong, hands-on performance marketing experience and have driven measurable business outcomes across multiple D2C/eCommerce brands.**

title: Marketing Operations Team Lead
description:
**About The Role**
We are seeking an experienced and versatile Team Lead for GCC Marketing Operations to own and scale the full spectrum of digital marketing execution for our global ecommerce platform. This is a high-impact leadership role within our rapidly expanding Global Capability Center (GCC) in Pune.
  
  
You will lead a multidisciplinary team responsible for CMS and web publishing, email campaigns, social media operations, and publications and content governance. This is not a siloed role. We need a leader who can orchestrate all four workstreams simultaneously, maintain quality across channels, manage stakeholder expectations from Belgium and global markets, and build a team culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  
  
You will be at the centre of building a world-class marketing operations engine.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**CMS & Web Publishing -**
You will own the end-to-end CMS publishing workflow, from intake and briefing through to QA, go-live, and post-launch review. You will ensure 95%+ on-time delivery and maintain a less than 1% post-launch error rate across all published assets. You will design and enforce standard operating procedures for briefing, template use, checklist enforcement, and publishing gates. You must have hands-on experience with our CMS platform (Drupal), ensure all published content meets on-page SEO standards, and verify layouts and functionality on desktop, tablet, and mobile before every go-live.
  
  
**Email Campaign Management -**
You will plan, build, test, and deploy promotional, transactional, and lifecycle email campaigns at scale. You will manage our email marketing platform with hands-on proficiency, design and execute A/B tests on subject lines, creative, and send times to optimise open rates and click-through rates, and ensure accurate audience segmentation, suppression lists, and GDPR compliance. You will monitor open rates, CTR, conversion rates, bounce rates, and unsubscribe rates, and report insights on a weekly basis. You will build and maintain triggered email automation flows including abandoned cart, browse abandonment, post-purchase, and welcome series, and design, maintain, and update responsive email templates aligned with brand guidelines.
  
  
**Social Media Operations -**
You will maintain a social media content calendar aligned with campaign schedules and market events, and use social media management tools to schedule and publish content across key channels. You will localise and adapt global social content for market-specific nuances, languages, and cultural context, and monitor comments and messages, escalating customer service issues to the relevant team. You will track reach, engagement, follower growth, and content performance, and share monthly insights with stakeholders. You will ensure all published content adheres to brand guidelines, legal requirements, and platform policies.
  
  
**Publications & Content Governance -**
You will oversee all marketing assets including images, videos, copy, and templates in our digital asset management system. You will ensure the correct version of every asset is used across all channels and markets, and manage translation workflows, market-specific adaptations, and cultural review processes. You will enforce brand guidelines across CMS, email, social, and printed publications, coordinate go-live dates across all channels to ensure campaign consistency and timing, and ensure all images, fonts, and content used have proper licensing and legal clearance. You will maintain clean, searchable archives of all published content for compliance and re-use.
  
  
**Must-Have**
**Required Experience & Skills**

* You must have 8+ years in digital marketing operations with hands-on experience across at least three of the following: CMS- Drupal, email marketing, social media operations, or content governance. You must have 4+ years leading a multidisciplinary team of 5 or more in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
* You must have 7+ years of hands-on experience with enterprise CMS platform Drupal You must have + years managing email campaigns and automation at scale, with proficiency in at least one major email service provider. You must have 3+ years using social media management platforms such as Hootsuite, Sprout Social, or Meta Business Suite.
* You must have a deep understanding of ecommerce content, campaigns, and customer journey touchpoints. You must have a proven ability to design standard operating procedures, enforce brand compliance, and manage complex publication workflows. You must have experience working with global stakeholders across time zones, with strong communication and negotiation skills. Prior experience in a Global Capability Center or offshore delivery model is required. Conduct CMS audits. Opportunist attitude to advice and consult on the possible solutions, be critical, and proactive solution identifier and provider Content Data analytics(content marketing points - to be read and identified) - nice to have
* You must be fluent in written and spoken English, and be a confident communicator with global leadership.
* Leading the GCC Mkt operation Pro-actively

**Nice-to-Have**

* Basic proficiency in Google Analytics, email performance dashboards, and social media analytics.
* Familiarity with design tools such as Figma, Adobe XD, or Canva for creative handoff and review.
* Experience with marketing automation platforms such as Marketo, HubSpot, or Salesforce.
* Experience using AI tools for content generation, proofreading, or workflow automation.
* Experience with Jira, sprint management, and agile delivery frameworks. Ability to work across multiple language markets - French, Dutch, or German is a strong plus.

**Personal Attributes**

* You are an orchestrator, not a specialist. You can juggle four or more workstreams simultaneously without dropping the ball on any of them.
* You have zero tolerance for sloppy work across any channel - CMS, email, social media, or publications.
* You maintain clarity and composure during campaign launches and tight multi-channel deadlines.
* You are a proactive communicator who flags risks early, updates stakeholders without being chased, and closes every loop. You take complete ownership of outcomes. There is no blame-shifting, no excuses, and no surprises. You are genuinely invested in growing your team members, creating career pathways, not just task lists.
* You understand how each channel contributes to revenue, conversion, and customer experience.
* You thrive in a scaling environment and are comfortable with ambiguity and rapid change.
* You handle difficult conversations with maturity and build psychological safety in your team.

title: Co-Founder
description:
**About Refactyl**

Refactyl is building a safer way to modernise software codebases.

We help developers migrate legacy code to modern frameworks and languages through deterministic transformation rules, AI-assisted changes, real compiler verification and reviewable diffs.

Our vision is to make code modernisation something developers can run, verify and review rather than a risky, manual rewrite.

Explore the product: https://www.refactyl.com

**Why this opportunity exists**

I'm Yash Sharma, the technical founder of Refactyl.

I've been building the product and working on the engineering behind it.

Now I want to find the right person to help turn Refactyl into a real, growing business.

I'm not looking for someone to execute marketing tasks.

I’m looking for an experienced co-founder who can handle marketing, sales, finding customers and growing the business to turn our product into a successful business with real users and paying customers.

**I want us to build the company together.**

**What you'll be responsible for**

* Finding our first users and paying customers.
* Identifying developers, engineering teams and businesses that need code modernisation.
* Conducting customer discovery and understanding why people would or wouldn't use Refactyl.
* Building an acquisition strategy through direct outreach, developer communities, partnerships, technical content, SEO, and other experiments.
* Turning product demonstrations and trials into active users and customers.
* Developing our positioning, messaging, and sales process.
* Measuring what works, learning from rejection, and continuously improving our approach.
* Helping shape the business strategy and long-term direction of Refactyl.

You'll have meaningful ownership over how we take this product to market.

**Who I want to meet**

**I'm looking for someone with real-world experience who has demonstrated the ability to turn a product or business into something people actually use and pay for.**

**This is not an entry-level marketing opportunity or a role for someone looking to learn sales from scratch.**

**I'm looking for a potential co-founder who can bring meaningful experience, independent thinking, and execution to the business.**

**You could be a strong fit if you have:**

* **Demonstrable growth or sales experience:**
  You've acquired customers, generated revenue, built a sales pipeline, grown a product's user base, or helped an early-stage business gain traction.
* **Startup experience:**
  You've worked at an early-stage startup, built your own business or taken a product from an idea to real customers.
* **B2B or SaaS experience:**
  You understand how to identify potential customers, conduct discovery calls, communicate value, and convert interest into adoption or revenue.
* **A track record of execution:**
  You can explain what you personally accomplished, the strategies you used, and the results you achieved.
* **Independent ownership:**
  You can identify opportunities, formulate a plan, execute it and learn from the results without needing constant direction.

Experience with developer tools, technical products, developer communities or selling to engineering teams would be a significant advantage.

You don't necessarily need experience at a famous company or a particular number of years in the industry. What matters is relevant experience, evidence of results, and the ability to apply that experience to an early-stage product.

**Please don't apply solely because you are interested in startups or want to learn marketing.**

I'm looking for someone who can contribute meaningful expertise from the beginning.

**How to apply**

**Please include the following in your application:**

1. **Your background:**
   A brief overview of your relevant professional experience, previous startups or businesses you've built.
2. **Your results:**
   One or two examples of products or businesses you've helped grow, customers you've acquired, revenue you've generated, or sales outcomes you've achieved. Include numbers and timeframes where possible, and clearly explain your personal contribution.
3. **Your approach:**
   How would you identify and acquire Refactyl's first 10 users and first paying customer?
4. **Your availability:**
   How much time can you realistically commit to building Refactyl?
5. **Your motivation:**
   Why do you want to join Refactyl as a co-founder, and what would you bring to the founding team?

Please include your LinkedIn profile and any relevant portfolio, case studies, startup projects, or other evidence of your work.

Applications that only express enthusiasm without demonstrating relevant experience or execution will not be prioritised.

**What I am offering**

* The opportunity to help shape an early-stage software company from the ground up.
* A technical founder focused on building and improving the product.
* Real ownership over growth and go-to-market decisions.
* An equity-based founding partnership, with the structure negotiated transparently.
* The opportunity to build something ambitious together.

**Important transparency**

Refactyl is currently at an early stage and is pre-revenue.

There is no guaranteed salary or upfront cash compensation at this time.

This is a founding partnership opportunity, not a salaried position.

Equity, vesting, responsibilities, commitment and decision-making will be discussed openly before we agree to work together.

I'm looking for someone who understands the risks and genuinely wants to build a business together, not someone being promised quick money or guaranteed success.

I'm looking for a person with initiative, conviction, and the ability to turn ideas into action.

If you're interested in building Refactyl with me, I'd love to hear from you.

title: Lead AI Engagement Specialist
description:
**Organization Overview**
**Company Description**
QAD | Redzone is building an enterprise AI platform to support AI-enabled and agentic workflows across the organisation. The AI Centre of Excellence (CoE) is accountable for turning that ambition into deployed, measured, production workflows across priority business functions.
  
  
The CoE is small, senior and high-leverage. It combines architecture and engineering with a set of functional AI Engagement Specialists who own the demand side: what gets built, why it is worth building, whether anyone uses it, and whether it actually works once live.
  
  
**Job Description**
The
**Lead AI Engagement Specialist**
owns a portfolio of AI workflows within one or more business functions, end to end. You will identify where AI genuinely changes how the work is done, redesign that work, write the PRD, drive the build with the architect and engineers, land the adoption, and then manage the performance of the agents in production as a product you are accountable for.
  
  
This is a product and transformation role, not a business analysis role. The distinction matters and we mean it: you will own a roadmap, write specifications precise enough to build from, make scope calls, and be measured on realised value rather than on delivered documentation. If a workflow does not clear its quality bar or nobody uses it, that is your problem to solve, not to report.
  
  
**Where this role sits**
**Reports to:**
Head of the AI Centre of Excellence
  
  
**Alignment:**
Dotted line to the leadership of the business function you cover
  
  
**Works with:**
AI Engagement specialists, Lead AI Architect and Senior AI Engineer daily; external implementation partners; Security, GRC, Legal and Data teams as required
  
  
**Owns:**
The prioritised workflow pipeline, PRDs, roadmap, adoption and live agent performance for one function. Lead & manage other AI Engagement specialists.
  
  
**Accountable for:**
Realised, measured business value — not deployment count
  
  
**What You Will Own**
**Opportunity identification and prioritisation**

* Own the AI workflow pipeline for your function — a ranked, evidence-based view of where AI creates value, refreshed as the business and the technology move.
* Distinguish rigorously between work that AI genuinely changes and work that merely looks automatable in a demo — and be willing to argue that a well-sponsored idea is not worth building.
* Prioritise on value, feasibility, data readiness, risk and time to impact, in partnership with the architect.

**Process discovery and workflow redesign**

* Map the current state properly: volumes, cycle times, cost to serve, exception paths, decision points, systems and data touched, and where the work actually breaks — grounded in observation and data, not in what the process document claims.
* Redesign the work, not just the tool. Decide what the agent does, what the human does, where the handoff sits, what the escalation path is, and what changes in roles, policies, SOPs and controls as a consequence.
* Design the human-in-the-loop model with the architect: where review is mandatory, where an agent may act autonomously, and how a wrong action is caught and reversed.

**Business case and value ownership**

* Build the business case: baseline metrics, benefit hypothesis, quantified target, build and run cost, payback and sensitivity — and the honest version of it, including the case against building.
* Establish the baseline before launch. A benefit that cannot be measured against a pre-existing baseline will not be believed, and should not be.
* Own benefits realisation after go-live — report the real number, including when it is below target, and recommend iterate, rebuild or retire accordingly.

**Product specification and roadmap**

* Write the PRD: problem, users, scope and non-scope, target workflow, acceptance criteria, quality bar, data and system dependencies, non-functional expectations, risks, and success metrics — detailed enough that the architect and engineers can design and build from it without a translation layer.
* Own the roadmap for your function: sequencing, dependencies, release planning, and a defensible view of what comes next and why.
* Partner with delivery daily — make scope calls, resolve ambiguity, unblock, test, and accept. Be available to engineers at the pace they work.

**Agent performance management**

* Define the quality bar in measurable terms with engineering — what a correct output is, what an acceptable error rate is, and what failure mode is unacceptable at any rate.
* Build and curate the evaluation datasets for your workflows, drawing on real cases from your function.
* Review live agent output on an ongoing basis and run the feedback loop back into engineering.
* Monitor production performance — accuracy and quality, containment or deflection, escalation rate, latency, cost per transaction, and user satisfaction — and drive the iteration cycle.
* Treat a live agent as a product under active management, not a project that was completed.

**Adoption and change**

* Own adoption as an outcome you are measured on: enablement, training, communications, champions, policy and SOP updates, and management routines.
* Instrument usage and act on what it shows — including the uncomfortable finding that a well-built workflow is being avoided.
* Engage with resistance seriously. Where people are working around the agent, understand why before attempting to change the behaviour.
* Work with function leadership on role definition, capacity and performance expectations as work is redesigned.

**Governance and CoE contribution**

* Ensure workflows meet responsible AI, data handling, privacy and approval requirements, working with Security, GRC and Legal.
* Feed reusable patterns back into the CoE so that a solved problem in one function does not get re-solved from scratch in another.

**Qualifications**

* 7+ years in product management, business or digital transformation, operations strategy, or top-tier consulting — with a track record of change that shipped and stuck, not recommendations that were accepted.
* Demonstrable ownership of product specifications or PRDs that engineering teams built from. We will ask to discuss one in detail.
* Strong process redesign capability. Lean, Six Sigma, service design or similar training is welcome; evidence of redesigned work in production matters more than certification.
* Business case and value modelling — comfort with baselines, unit economics, cost to serve and payback, and the intellectual honesty to model the downside.
* Data literacy: able to interrogate data, work with BI tooling, and define and track metrics that hold up to scrutiny.
* Working fluency in what current AI systems can and cannot do — retrieval, agents, hallucination and grounding, evaluation, human-in-the-loop, and cost. Enough to scope realistically with engineers and to push back on hype and on pessimism with equal confidence. Coding is not required.
* Change management and adoption experience with real end users, including users who did not ask for the change.
* Strong influence at senior levels without formal authority, and the standing to tell a function leader that their favourite idea is not the right first build.
* Excellent written communication — clear specifications, clear reasoning, clear status.
* Deep functional expertise in the business function this opening covers — the specific requirements are set out under “Functional depth” below.

**Functional depth**
This role requires credibility with practitioners and leaders inside the function from the first week. We are looking for someone who understands how the work is genuinely done — its operating rhythm, its systems, its economics and its performance measures — well enough to challenge how it is done today rather than to describe it.
  
  
**Strongly Preferred**

* Enterprise B2B SaaS experience.
* Manufacturing, supply chain or ERP domain knowledge.
* Having deployed AI or automation into production and lived with the results — including a deployment that underperformed and what you did about it.
* Experience operating across multiple regions and time zones.
* Experience working alongside system integrators or external delivery partners.

**What This Role Is Not**

* Not a process documentation role. Mapping is an input; redesigned, adopted, measured work is the output.
* Not a change communications role. You own the product, not the announcement.
* Not a requirements-gathering role. You will not hand a wish list to engineering and wait; you will specify, decide and stay accountable through production.
* Not a role that ends at go-live. Managing agent performance afterwards is a permanent part of the job.

**What Success Looks Like**
**First 3 months**

* A credible, ranked workflow pipeline for your functions, grounded in real process data and endorsed by function leadership.
* The first one or two PRDs written and accepted into build by the architect and engineering without a translation gap.
* Baselines established for the metrics your first workflows will move.

**First 6 months**

* First workflows live in production, with adoption instrumented and quality actively monitored.
* A functioning feedback loop between live agent performance and the engineering backlog.
* A 12-month roadmap for your function that leadership has signed up to.

**First 12 months**

* Measured, defensible business value delivered against pre-established baselines — reported honestly, including where the result fell short.
* Adoption at a level where the redesigned workflow is the normal way the work is done, not an optional tool.
* At least one reusable pattern contributed to the CoE and adopted by another function.
* A function that is materially more capable of absorbing the next wave than it was when you joined.

**How We Assess**

* Portfolio conversation — a transformation or product initiative you owned end to end, including the value actually realised versus the value forecast.
* Written exercise — a short PRD or workflow redesign on a realistic problem from your function.
* Working session with the AI CoE on scoping and quality definition for a live QAD workflow.
* Stakeholder interview with leadership from the function you would cover.

**Additional Information**

* Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work-life balance.
* Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation.
* Collaborative culture of smart and hard-working people who support one another to get the job done.
* An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy.
* Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set

**About QAD**
QAD | Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars — Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) — QAD | Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days.
  
  
QAD is committed to ensuring that every employee feels they work in an environment that values their contributions, respects their unique perspectives and provides opportunities for growth regardless of background. QAD’s DEI program is driving higher levels of diversity, equity and inclusion so that employees can bring their whole self to work.
  
  
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

title: Water Domain Business Lead
description:
**Job Title**
: Water Domain Business Lead

**Location**
: India (Pune, Chennai, Hyderabad, Delhi)

**Job Summary**

The Water Domain Business Lead is responsible for building and growing strategic client relationships across the water and wastewater utilities sector. The role combines domain leadership, consultative business development, account planning, solution shaping, and ecosystem collaboration to create qualified demand and convert opportunities into sustainable revenue. The position acts as a trusted business advisor to clients, connects business priorities with TCS capabilities, and orchestrates cross-functional teams to deliver differentiated, outcome-led propositions.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. **Achieves Revenue & Pipeline Targets through Demand Creation**

* Identify and develop demand across water and wastewater utilities by connecting client priorities with relevant TCS capabilities, industry solutions, digital engineering, IoT, data, cloud, asset management, operational technology, and transformation services.
* Build and maintain a healthy, qualified opportunity pipeline through executive conversations, account workshops, industry insights, targeted campaigns, partner propositions, and proactive solution concepts.
* Lead opportunity origination and early-stage qualification, establish business value, define the buying context, and shape a clear path from client need to funded initiative.
* Work with sales, accounts, consulting, delivery, solution, and partner teams to improve conversion from lead to qualified opportunity and from opportunity to closure.
* Monitor the pipeline for value, probability, ageing, competitive position, decision milestones, and dependencies, and initiate timely recovery actions where required.

**2 Ownership of Targets**

* Own agreed revenue, order-book, pipeline, and demand-generation targets for the water domain, with clear accountability for performance and forecast accuracy.
* Translate annual business objectives into account-level and solution-level pursuits, measurable milestones, and disciplined execution plans.
* Maintain visibility of target attainment, risks, gaps, and corrective actions, and provide evidence-based updates to leadership.
* Balance short-term pursuit conversion with medium-term pipeline development and long-term strategic account growth.

**3 Positions TCS as Business Advisor**

* Develop a strong understanding of each client’s business strategy, operational challenges, regulatory context, investment priorities, technology landscape, and transformation agenda.
* Engage client executives and business leaders with a point of view on sector trends, operational resilience, customer and environmental outcomes, asset performance, data-led decision-making, and digital transformation.
* Create client-specific value propositions, business cases, roadmaps, maturity assessments, and executive narratives that clearly link TCS capabilities to measurable business outcomes.
* Bring relevant TCS experience, reusable assets, alliances, and cross-industry innovation into client discussions without presenting generic or technology-led propositions.
* Build credibility through domain depth, commercial awareness, structured problem solving, and consistent follow-through.

**4 Alliance Led Growth**

* Define and execute alliance-led growth strategies for the water domain by aligning TCS capabilities with complementary technology, engineering, platform, and industry-partner offerings.
* Identify priority alliance partners and jointly develop differentiated propositions, market plays, account-entry strategies, and repeatable solution patterns for water and wastewater utilities.
* Create joint go-to-market plans covering target clients, demand-generation campaigns, executive engagement, workshops, demonstrations, thought leadership, and industry events.
* Work with alliance, sales, consulting, solution, and delivery teams to originate and qualify partner-influenced opportunities and establish clear ownership across the pursuit lifecycle.
* Develop joint value propositions and business cases that define the client outcome, combined capabilities, delivery responsibilities, commercial model, and competitive differentiation.
* Maintain governance for alliance pursuits, including opportunity tracking, pipeline contribution, partner commitments, solution dependencies, risks, and agreed next actions.
* Strengthen partner relationships through regular business reviews, shared account planning, solution enablement, credential development, and structured knowledge exchange.

**5 Collaboration & Networking**

* Create effective virtual teams across sales, account management, consulting, delivery, engineering, industry units, centers of excellence, alliances, and marketing.
* Build a strong internal network to mobilize the right subject-matter experts, credentials, accelerators, and leadership sponsorship for each opportunity.
* Develop relationships with technology and industry partners to shape complementary propositions and strengthen market access.
* Encourage knowledge sharing across geographies and accounts, including reuse of proven case studies, solution patterns, lessons learned, and proposal content.
* Represent the water domain in relevant client forums, internal communities, industry events, and partner engagements.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

**Education**

Bachelor's degree in engineering, technology, environmental sciences, business, or a related discipline.

A postgraduate qualification in business, management, utilities, or a related field is desirable.

**Experience**

* 10+ experience in the water and wastewater utilities sector, with a strong understanding of utility business, operational, asset, customer, environmental, and regulatory priorities.
* Proven experience in business development, consulting, client relationship management, account growth, solution shaping, or strategic sales in a complex B2B environment with $20M+ target achievement.
* Demonstrated ability to originate and qualify opportunities, influence senior stakeholders, coordinate multi-disciplinary teams, and support complex pursuits through closure.
* Experience developing client-specific propositions, business cases, account plans, executive presentations, and proposal responses.
* Experience working across geographies and with distributed teams, alliance partners, and delivery organizations is desirable.

**Technical Skills**

* Water and wastewater utility domain knowledge, including core business processes and the operating context of asset-intensive utilities.
* Working knowledge of digital utility capabilities such as operational technology and IT convergence, SCADA and telemetry, IoT, data platforms, analytics and AI, GIS, asset management, digital twins, cloud, and cyber security.
* Ability to translate technical capabilities into business outcomes, value drivers, implementation roadmaps, and differentiated propositions.
* Strong capability in opportunity qualification, pipeline management, forecasting, account planning, commercial awareness, and proposal governance.
* Proficiency in creating executive-ready presentations, structured documents, business cases, and management reports.
* Soft Skills
* Executive presence and the ability to communicate credibly with business, operational, and technology stakeholders.
* Consultative listening, structured problem solving, commercial judgement, and a strong client-outcome orientation.
* Influencing and negotiation skills, with the ability to align stakeholders without relying on formal authority.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and facilitation skills.
* Collaboration, cultural awareness, adaptability, resilience, and disciplined follow-through.
* High standards of integrity, confidentiality, accountability, and attention to detail.

**Measures of Success**

* Achievement of agreed revenue, order-book, qualified-pipeline, and demand-creation outcomes.
* Quality, coverage, progression, and forecast accuracy of the water-domain opportunity pipeline.
* Growth in strategic client relationships, executive access, and TCS participation in priority transformation initiatives.
* Conversion of differentiated propositions into qualified pursuits and successful outcomes.
* Effectiveness of cross-functional collaboration, governance adherence, and leadership reporting.
* Contribution to reusable water-domain assets, thought leadership, partner propositions, and team capability.

Competitor ProductsPricing Bundles Offers Reviews Ratings Product positioning Claims Landing pages Amazon listings Audience IntelligenceWho are competitors speaking to? title: Brand Lead
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a creative, strategic and execution-focused
**Brand Manager**
to drive the brand journey for Bajaj Broking across
**ATL, BTL and TTL**
channels.

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of
**brand building, campaign strategy, consumer communication and design**
, along with the ability to translate business objectives into impactful marketing campaigns.

This role will work closely with internal stakeholders, creative agencies, media partners, digital teams and business teams to build a consistent and differentiated brand presence for Bajaj Broking.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Brand Strategy & Management**

* Develop and execute brand strategies aligned with business and marketing objectives.
* Strengthen Bajaj Broking's brand positioning, proposition and communication.
* Ensure consistency of brand identity and messaging across all consumer touchpoints.
* Manage and evolve brand guidelines, tone of voice, visual identity and communication standards.
* Track market trends, competitor communication and consumer behavior to identify opportunities.

**ATL / BTL / TTL Marketing**

* Plan and execute integrated
  **ATL, BTL and TTL campaigns**
  across relevant channels.
* Conceptualize campaigns from brief to execution, ensuring strong consumer impact and brand consistency.
* Work with creative and media agencies to develop campaign concepts, communication assets and media plans.
* Manage offline brand activations, events, OOH, print, radio, partnerships and other relevant touchpoints.
* Ensure seamless integration between offline and digital campaigns.

**Creative & Design**

* Strong understanding of
  **design principles, visual communication and creative storytelling**
  .
* Work closely with designers and creative agencies to develop campaign creatives, key visuals, digital assets and marketing collaterals.
* Ability to independently review and provide constructive feedback on designs, layouts, typography, colors and overall visual communication.
* Ensure all creative output adheres to Bajaj Broking's brand guidelines.
* Translate complex financial products and propositions into simple, engaging and consumer-friendly communication.

**Campaign & Product Marketing**

* Develop marketing campaigns for new product launches, product enhancements and business initiatives.
* Create campaign briefs covering objectives, target audience, proposition, messaging and communication strategy.
* Partner with Product, Business, Digital, Sales and Customer Experience teams to drive successful launches.
* Monitor campaign performance and identify opportunities for optimization.

**Digital & Social**

* Collaborate with digital marketing and social media teams to ensure consistent brand communication.
* Provide strategic direction for digital campaigns, social media content and online brand initiatives.
* Understand how brand communication translates across websites, apps, social platforms and digital journeys.

**Agency & Stakeholder Management**

* Manage relationships with creative, media, production, digital and activation agencies.
* Prepare and manage creative briefs, timelines and campaign deliverables.
* Ensure quality, timelines and budgets are effectively managed.
* Work with senior stakeholders to align communication with business priorities.

**Market & Competitor Insights**

* Monitor competitor campaigns, communication strategies and industry trends.
* Conduct consumer and market research to identify emerging opportunities.
* Use insights to improve brand communication and campaign effectiveness.

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* Strong understanding of
  **Brand Management and Integrated Marketing**
  .
* Hands-on experience across
  **ATL, BTL and TTL marketing**
  .
* Strong creative and visual sense with an understanding of design.
* Excellent campaign conceptualization and execution skills.
* Strong copy and communication understanding.
* Experience in managing creative and media agencies.
* Ability to manage multiple campaigns and stakeholders simultaneously.
* Strong project management and execution skills.
* Data-driven approach to measuring campaign effectiveness.
* Strong understanding of the financial services / fintech / stock broking ecosystem will be an advantage.

**Preferred Background**

* MBA/PGDM in Marketing or equivalent qualification.
* 9–12 years of experience in
  **Brand Management, Integrated Marketing, Advertising or Marketing Communications**
  .
* Experience in
  **financial services, fintech, BFSI, stock broking or consumer-facing digital businesses**
  preferred.
* Candidates from leading agencies with strong experience in managing brands and integrated campaigns may also be considered.

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for someone who is:

**Strategic + Creative + Hands-on + Business-oriented**

The person should be comfortable moving between
**brand strategy, campaign ideation, creative reviews, agency management and execution**
, while keeping the larger business objective at the center of every campaign.

title: Director of Product Management
description:
**Job Title:**
Director of Product Management

**Location:**
Pune

**Experience:**
10+ years

About the Opportunity

We are seeking a hands-on product leader to drive the development and expansion of digital products for a growing fintech business. This role is suited to someone who enjoys solving complex customer and business problems, combining technology with commercial thinking, and taking responsibility for product outcomes from early-stage discovery through scale.

The person will play a key role in advancing AI-enabled product capabilities while improving the experience of both business partners and end customers.

What You'll Be Responsible For

* Lead product planning and delivery across key platform initiatives, ensuring product decisions address genuine customer needs and business opportunities.
* Explore practical applications of machine learning, generative AI and AI agents to improve personalisation, automation, decision-making and overall product effectiveness.
* Identify unmet customer needs and market opportunities through user research, data analysis, competitive assessment and feedback from business partners.
* Convert product opportunities into clear requirements, prioritised roadmaps and actionable plans for engineering and design teams.
* Work closely with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Marketing and Business teams to deliver products efficiently and manage competing priorities.
* Own product performance through defined metrics, regularly assessing adoption, engagement, conversion, revenue and operational effectiveness as relevant to the product.
* Make informed trade-offs between customer experience, technical feasibility, delivery timelines and commercial objectives.
* Use customer insights and product analytics to identify friction points and continuously improve product performance.
* Contribute to the development of product management talent through collaboration, mentoring and strong product practices.
* Present product plans, progress and performance insights to senior stakeholders, ensuring alignment on priorities and expected outcomes.

What We're Looking For

* 10+ years of overall experience, including substantial experience in product management and ownership of technology products.
* Experience building and growing digital products in fintech, payments, consumer technology, B2B or B2C platforms or other transaction-oriented businesses.
* Evidence of taking products from problem identification and validation through launch, adoption and subsequent optimisation.
* Experience delivering AI/ML-powered features or products, with an understanding of how data, models and product workflows work together.
* Ability to assess the suitability of AI for a business problem and understand the practical considerations involved in deployment, quality measurement and ongoing monitoring.
* Familiarity with generative AI, LLM applications, AI agents and prompt/context design is desirable; the ability to build and test prototypes is a strong advantage.
* Strong analytical skills, with experience using product metrics and customer insights to prioritise initiatives and evaluate results.
* Ability to work effectively with engineering teams, understand technical dependencies and communicate product requirements clearly.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication and decision-making skills.
* A proactive, ownership-driven approach with the flexibility to work through ambiguity and engage directly in execution when necessary.

title: AVP – Partnerships & Operations (Founder’s Office)
description:
**About Robotex India**

Robotex India is a non-profit on a mission to make future skills (robotics, coding, AI, IoT and STEAM) accessible to every child from government schools and colleges
in India.

Founded in Pune in 2018, Robotex India brought one of the world’s largest robotics festival, Robotex International, to Indian classrooms. Our focus has been on children who rarely get this opportunity: students in government, rural and tribal schools/colleges, majorly first-generation learners.

**What we’ve built so far**

* **Scale:**
  1.5 million+ students reached across 15 states and 500+ schools
* **Teachers:**
  300,000 teachers training in progress on AI in pedagogy with Microsoft
* **Girls in STEM:**
  520,000+ girls brought into robotics, coding, STEM and AI
* **Robotex for Rural:**
  a CSR-funded programme, launched in 2019, that teaches coding, programming, AI and robotics to students from marginalised communities
* **Government partnerships:**
  we work directly with state governments and Zila Parishads so that programmes reach the most underserved communities
* **India’s first digital hackathon:**
  organised during the pandemic with FICCI FLO Pune and the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, keeping learning alive when schools shut
* **National Championship:**
  the Robotex India National Championship is one of the country’s largest grassroots technology platforms. So far 250+ government school students won podium places and represented India at Robotex International in Estonia. All from government, rural and tribal schools.
* **STEAM and robotics labs:**
  set up in government schools and colleges through CSR sponsors
* **Innoveda:**
  our future-skills programme for schools and colleges, now expanding to new cities

**The Role**

This is the most important hire we’ll make this year.

You’ll be directly working with the Founder: a senior leader who shares the load across fundraising, grants, operations, growth and outreach, and who owns outcomes end to end. You’ll be handed goals and trusted to get there.

This role suits a seasoned AVP or senior manager from the NGO, CSR or development sector. It also suits an exceptional, qualified Executive Manager or Chief of Staff who is ready to step up and grow into a leadership position. What matters most is ownership, judgement and drive.

You’ll report directly to the Founder & Director and work closely with the programme, finance, outreach and digital teams.

What You’ll Do

1. **Fundraising & CSR Partnerships**

* Build and manage a pipeline of prospective CSR partners, foundations, HNIs and institutional donors
* Research companies’ CSR priorities and Schedule VII alignment, and match them to Robotex India programmes
* Lead pitches from first meeting to signed MoU, with tailored proposals, decks and budgets
* Grow existing partnerships through renewals, expanded scope, multi-year commitments and new geographies
* Manage donor relationships with regular updates, impact stories, site visits and event invitations
* Keep the funding pipeline, forecasts and partner database up to date in a CRM or tracker

2. Grant Management

* Track grant opportunities from CSR, government, multilateral and international funders
* Lead applications from research and concept note through to full proposal and submission
* Own the post-award cycle: deliverables, timelines, milestones and funder commitments
* Prepare progress, impact and financial reports with the programme and finance teams
* Ensure compliance with funder requirements, including utilisation certificates, audit support and CSR-1 / 12A / 80G documentation
* Build a clean, audit-ready grant documentation system

3. Operations

* Oversee programme delivery across states, schools and districts to time, budget and quality
* Coordinate with trainers, coordinators and volunteers for workshops, labs and competitions
* Support the Robotex India National Championship: planning, logistics, partners and team travel for the international finals
* Build SOPs, trackers, dashboards and reviews that let the organisation run without bottlenecks
* Coordinate with finance on budgets, vendor payments, procurement and cost control
* Support hiring, onboarding and performance rhythms for the team

4. Growth & Innoveda Outreach

* Drive Innoveda’s expansion to new schools and cities, from outreach to onboarding
* Open partnerships with school groups, universities, state education departments and Zila Parishads
* Identify new programme and revenue opportunities that strengthen long-term sustainability
* Represent Robotex India at conferences, CSR forums, education events and government meetings

5. Digital Footprint & Communications

* Oversee our social media, website and digital presence with the digital team
* Make sure donors, schools and partners consistently see credible, up-to-date impact stories
* Build impact communications: case studies, annual reports, partner decks and newsletters
* Strengthen Robotex India’s and the Founder’s visibility in media, LinkedIn and sector platforms

6. Founder’s Office

* Manage the Founder’s priorities, calendar, meetings, travel and follow-ups
* Prepare briefs, notes and documents for partner, donor and government meetings
* Track key decisions and commitments, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks
* Act as the Founder’s representative with partners, donors and the team when needed
* Bring fresh thinking: spot problems early, propose solutions and run with them

**What Success Looks Like**

**In your first 30 days:**
you know every programme, partner and grant in our portfolio, and you’ve taken ownership of the funding pipeline and grant calendar.

**In 90 days:**
you’ve closed or renewed CSR partnerships, submitted new grant applications, and put working systems in place for reporting and operations.
