title: Social Media Manager
description:
**Job Description**
**Position Summary:**
 VOPA is looking for a Manager, Social Media and Communications, to lead the strategy, storytelling and brand\-building for our work across education, mental health, life\-skills and technology\-for\-good. This is not a content\-posting role: it requires someone who understands the science behind social media (algorithms, audience behaviour, analytics) and who can independently grasp the substance of any VOPA project, whether it is a literacy assessment, a de\-addiction programme, or a teacher mental\-health initiative. Deep prior knowledge is not required, but the candidate must be curious enough to ask why, when, where, who and how before turning field work into a post, and confident enough to judge what is worth telling on LinkedIn or Instagram. This person will build VOPA into a recognised, credible brand in the education and social impact space.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own and drive VOPA's social media and communications strategy across LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and other relevant platforms, aligned with organisational and project goals.
* Before developing any content, understand the project (purpose, context, target group, impact) by asking the right questions: why this intervention, when and why it started, who it serves, what has changed.
* Translate technical and programmatic work (assessments, field data, research, government partnerships) from verticals such as NIPUN Maharashtra, Saiyam, MYCA and Digital Learning into content that is accurate, compelling and easy for a public audience to follow.
* Apply an understanding of platform algorithms and audience behaviour to decide what to post, when, and in what format, rather than following a generic content calendar.
* Plan, create, edit, publish and manage a consistent content calendar (text, graphics, reels, videos, stories) that reflects VOPA's voice and priorities.
* Coordinate with programme, field and research teams to source real stories, data, testimonials, photographs and videos, and verify facts before they go out publicly.
* Track reach, engagement and growth metrics, benchmark against comparable organisations, and report impact regularly to leadership.
* Maintain brand consistency (visual identity, tone of voice, messaging) across all social media accounts, collateral and external communication.
* Support donor and partner visibility needs, including acknowledgement posts, event coverage, and inputs for annual reports and case studies.
* Guide and review the work of any social media or design associates, interns or freelancers supporting the function.
* Maintain and submit monthly and quarterly communications reports, content plans and expense records.


**Qualifications**
 A bachelor's or master's degree in mass communication, journalism, marketing, digital media, social work or a related field. Certifications in social media marketing, analytics or graphic design will be an advantage.
   

  

**Experience**
* Minimum 4 to 6 years of experience in social media management and/or communications, with at least part of this in the development sector, non\-profit space or a mission\-driven organisation.
* Demonstrated experience independently building and executing a social media or communications strategy, not only running content calendars set by others.
* Proven ability to understand unfamiliar subject matter quickly and translate it into public\-facing content.
* Experience managing or mentoring junior team members, interns or freelance designers is preferred.


**Skills**
* Strong grasp of the science of social media: platform algorithms, analytics, audience segmentation and what drives genuine engagement, not just likes.
* Ability to grasp the substance of diverse projects (education, de\-addiction, mental health, technology) with limited prior knowledge, by asking structured questions (why, when, where, who, how) and applying that logic to content.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; working knowledge of Marathi and/or Hindi is an advantage.
* Hands\-on proficiency with Canva, Adobe Creative Suite or equivalent design tools, and basic video/reel editing.
* Comfort reading data and M\&E reports and mining them for content ideas and proof points.
* Analytical mindset, able to set metrics, track performance and adapt strategy based on what the data shows.


**Values**
 Curiosity, discipline, drive for social action, integrity, hard work, and ownership of the VOPA brand.
   

  

**Office Location:** 
 Kothrud, Pune
   

  

**Salary: Rs. 6,00,000 to Rs. 9,00,000 per annum (CTC), depending on experience and fit.**

**Website:** 
 https://careers.vopa.in/

 hr.vopa@vopa.in
   

  

 Salary Range
   

  

 6\.00 \- 9\.00 LPA

title: Senior Marketing Specialist
description:
***Build the voice. Shape the brand. Make people notice.***




  





**About the Role** 




  





 We’re looking for a Senior Marketing Generalist who wants to do more than make marketing plans.
 



  





 You’ll be one of the people shaping how
 **Plutas.ai and DigiSafe** 
**Insurance** 
 are seen, heard and remembered, from the content that appears on someone’s LinkedIn feed to the campaigns, events, stories and ideas that make people stop and pay attention.
 



  





 This is a role for someone who enjoys being
 **behind the scenes and in the middle of everything:** 
 spotting an opportunity, coming up with an idea, figuring out how to make it happen, and then watching it go live.
 



  





 You’ll work closely with leadership, sales, product and have the opportunity to build marketing initiatives from the ground up.
 



  





 If you’re someone who is naturally curious, has strong opinions about good content, understands what makes people engage, and likes turning ideas into action, we’d like to meet you.
 



  





**What You’ll Own** 




  





***Be the voice of the brand***




  





 \* Help shape and evolve the voice, personality and presence of
 **Plutas AI and DigiSafe Insurance** 
 .
 



 \* Create and manage content across LinkedIn, social media, websites, email and other relevant channels.
 



 \* Turn company updates, product developments, customer stories and industry conversations into content people actually want to read.
 



 \* Bring consistency to how our brands communicate, while keeping the communication human, relevant and current.
 



  





**Turn ideas into campaigns** 




  





 \* Conceptualise and execute marketing campaigns from idea to launch.
 



 \* Experiment with new formats, platforms, partnerships and ways of reaching our audience.
 



 \* Work with creative teams, agencies and internal stakeholders to bring campaigns to life.
 



 \* Take an idea from a WhatsApp conversation or whiteboard to something people see in the real world.
 



  





**Be close to the business** 




  





 \* Understand our products, customers and market deeply enough to tell compelling stories around them.
 



 \* Work closely with Sales and Product to understand what the business needs from marketing.
 



 \* Support demand generation, customer engagement and brand\-building initiatives.
 



 \* Identify opportunities where marketing can create a measurable business impact.
 



  





**Own our presence in the market** 




  





 \* Keep an eye on what is happening across AI, insurance, technology, consumer behaviour and the broader market.
 



 \* Spot conversations, trends and opportunities that our brands should be part of.
 



 \* Help build partnerships, events, activations and other initiatives that put the brands in front of the right people.
 



 \* Think beyond “posting content” \- think about \*\*how we become a brand people recognise and remember.\*\*
 



  





**Use data, but don’t lose the instinct** 




  





 \* Track campaign and content performance.
 



 \* Understand what is working, what isn't and why.
 



 \* Use data to improve campaigns, channels and content.
 



 \* Balance analytics with creativity, experimentation and good marketing judgment.
 



  





**What We’re Looking For** 




  





 We’re
 **not** 
 looking for someone who only knows how to execute a predefined marketing calendar.
 



  





 We’re looking for someone who:
 



  





 \* Has 2–5 years of marketing experience, ideally in a startup, technology, insurance or other fast\-moving environment.
 



 \* Is genuinely interested in
 **brands, content, culture and consumer behaviour** 




 \* Has strong written and verbal communication skills.
 



 \* Can write something that sounds like a human wrote it \- not a corporate template.
 



 \* Has a strong sense of what makes content interesting, relevant and shareable.
 



 \* Is comfortable working across content, social media, campaigns, events, partnerships and digital marketing.
 



 \* Can move comfortably between
 **big\-picture thinking and getting things done** 
 .
 



 \* Is comfortable with ambiguity and doesn't need every step mapped out.
 



 \* Can manage multiple priorities without losing ownership.
 



 \* Understands basic marketing analytics and is comfortable using data to make decisions.
 



 \* Is comfortable using tools such as Canva, Google Analytics, Meta/Google Ads, LinkedIn and Google Workspace. Experience with other marketing tools is a plus.
 



 \* Has a builder's mindset \- if something doesn't exist, you're excited about creating it.
 



  





 The Kind of Person Who Will Thrive Here
 



  





 You might be a great fit if you:
 



  





**\*\*Notice things.\*\*** 




 You see a campaign, LinkedIn post, brand or event and immediately think about why it worked.
 



  





**\*\*Have ideas.\*\*** 




 You don't wait for a brief to start thinking. You naturally spot opportunities and bring them to the table.
 



  





**\*\*Can execute.\*\*** 




 You don't just say \*“we should do this.”\* You figure out how to make it happen.
 



  





**\*\*Care about the details.\*\*** 




 The headline, the visual, the timing, the tone — you know the little things matter.
 



  





**\*\*Are curious.\*\*** 




 You like learning about new industries, technologies, audiences and platforms.
 



  





**\*\*Have a point of view.\*\*** 




 You can say, \*“I don't think this will work — here's what we should do instead.”\*
 



  





**\*\*Enjoy building.\*\*** 




 You want to look back six months later and see something that exists because \*\*you built it.\*\*
 



  





***Come build the voice behind Plutas AI and DigiSafe Insurance.***

title: Assistant General Manager - Marketing
description:
**About the job** 




  





**Get to know us better** 




 We are Gera Developments Private Limited (GDPL), a brand known by our five\-decade history as one of the pioneers in the Real Estate business in Pune. Innovation, transparency, and enhanced customer experience is how we have created award\-winning, premium residential and commercial projects in Pune, Goa, Bengaluru, and California. We live and work by “Let’s Outdo”, a philosophy that defines everything we do to raise the standards of Real Estate in the country.
 



 There are many ‘firsts’ that stand to our credit. Way back in 2004, we introduced India’s first 5\-year Warranty on Real Estate, that RERA mandated only in 2017\. We then introduced India’s first and only 7\-year warranty in Real Estate. In 2014, we designed and launched the award\-winning ChildCentric® Homes, which revolutionised the Real Estate sector for both, the developer, and the home buyer. IntelliplexesTM, SkyVillasTM, and The Imperium series are our other highly successful product lines. In our 50th Year, we launched yet another first\-of\-its\-kind industry initiative—Gera’s Home Equity Power—a means to provide financial flexibility to customers to meet financial emergencies.
 



  





**How the world sees us** 




 It has been an honour to be recognised as an innovative business leader, and an employer to build a career with by some of the best talent in the country.
 



 We’re the only Real Estate company to be recognised in the top 10 mid\-size organisations six times in a row by the Great Places to Work® Institute, and we continue to feature amongst the Top 50 Great Mid\-Size WorkplacesTM 2024 in India. In 2024, we have also been proudly recognised as one of India’s Best WorkplacesTM in Real Estate, and India’s Best WorkplacesTM in Building a Culture of Innovation for All. As we raise the bar on service orientation, product innovation, real estate marketing, and brand building, we are consciously creating a workplace where our employees achieve new heights in their areas of expertise.
 



  





**Our people\-forward culture** 




 How did we achieve this? By cheering for our outdoers. We care about our people, and invest in their success. We cultivate a culture of innovation, inclusiveness, high growth and rewards, inspiring our employees to challenge themselves, and besting their own past performance to achieve their professional goals and their self\-development objectives.
 



  





**Position Overview:** 




 We are seeking an experienced marketing leader with 10\+ years of experience at Gera Developments. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in brand strategy, customer lifecycle management, digital marketing, tech\-enabled customer journeys, and team leadership. As a key driver of business growth, you will be responsible for driving demand generation, enhancing customer experience, and strengthening the Gera brand across domestic and international markets.
 








**Key Responsibilities:** 




**Strategic Marketing \& Business Growth** 



* Lead development and execution of integrated marketing strategies aligned with company’s growth vision and brand objectives.
* Drive 30%\+ YoY business growth through performance marketing, direct, D2H channels, and referral/loyalty programs.
* Devising GTM strategies for project launches (₹3000\+ Cr portfolio), ensuring positioning, pricing, and promotion excellence.








**Customer Lifecycle \& Experience Management** 



* Own the customer journey from acquisition to handover, improve advocacy and reduce acquisition cost.
* Integrate digital platforms (Salesforce, SAP, Razorpay) to streamline experience and operations across customer touchpoints.
* Champion CX innovations.








**Budget \& Performance Management** 



* Manage and optimize ₹40\+ Cr marketing budgets with data\-backed ROI accountability across media, digital, and offline platforms.
* Analyze marketing KPIs, campaign performance, and consumer insights to refine strategy and improve efficiency.








**Team Leadership \& Stakeholder Collaboration** 



* Lead and mentor a high\-performing team; drive talent development, internal growth, and organizational alignment.
* Collaborate with leadership, sales, product, and tech teams to ensure strategic coherence and execution excellence.








**Marketing Ancillaries** 



* Lead marketing strategy for allied business verticals like The Gera School
* Represent Gera at industry forums, exhibitions, award platforms, and partner meets, enhancing corporate reputation.








**Ideal Candidate must possess:** 



* 10\+ years of progressive experience in marketing, brand strategy, digital growth, and customer experience.
* Proven success in driving large\-scale marketing programs, preferably in real estate, lifestyle, or service\-led sectors.
* Strong analytical and decision\-making skills with a data\-driven mindset.
* Expertise in CRM systems, marketing automation, and digital ecosystems (Salesforce, SAP, HubSpot, etc.).
* Excellent leadership, interpersonal, and communication skills.
* MBA in Marketing or equivalent from a reputed institution

title: Senior Marketplaces Advertising Strategist..
description:
This is not a reporting seat or an execution\-only role. You will own the advertising performance of your accounts end\-to\-end — strategy, targets, partner relationship, and outcomes — and act as the eyes and ears of the ads function on the ground. That means proactively surfacing risks, opportunities, and optimisation calls before partners or leadership have to ask, and translating what the data is telling us into decisions and action.
   

  

**You will work side\-by\-side with the Marketplaces Advertising Lead, supporting them to deliver against team\-level commercial targets while running your own book of accounts with autonomy. You will be hands\-on across Amazon Ads, Amazon DSP, and Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC), and equally comfortable leading a partner conversation about commercial strategy as you are inside a bid management interface.**
 ₹0 \- ₹0 a year
   

  

**Account Ownership \& Strategy Leadership**
* Own a portfolio of strategic brand accounts end\-to\-end — you are the senior strategist accountable for advertising performance against agreed commercial targets (revenue, ROAS, TACoS, new\-to\-brand, share of voice)
* Define quarterly and monthly advertising strategies for each account, aligned to partner commercial goals — growth, profitability, launches, defence, and category share
* Lead the advertising conversation in partner meetings, monthly performance reviews, and quarterly business reviews — own the narrative on what happened, why, what we are doing next, and what to expect
* Be the eyes and ears of the ads function — proactively flag what is working, what is at risk, and what to do about it, ahead of partners or leadership asking
* Partner with the Marketplaces Advertising Lead to hit portfolio\-level targets; raise pacing, performance, and budget risks early and bring the recommended call, not just the problem


**Campaign Strategy \& Optimisation**
* Plan, execute, and monitor paid advertising campaigns on Amazon (Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display) and Amazon DSP for your strategic accounts
* Lead optimisation across the portfolio — campaign structure, keyword strategy, negatives, bid strategy, audience targeting, creative direction, and budget pacing
* Test, scale, and retire — design structured tests (bid, placement, creative, audience), interpret results with rigour, and roll winners into the playbook
* Plan and manage weekly and monthly advertising budgets across your accounts; keep spend on pace and on strategy
* Continuously improve the tracking of brand\-level ad spend and return on ad spend, and the way we report performance to partners


**Amazon Marketing Cloud, DSP \& Advanced Advertising**
* Use Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC) as a core part of how you build strategy — path\-to\-conversion, audience overlap, incrementality, new\-to\-brand analysis
* Run and interpret Amazon DSP campaigns and analytics — quantify how upper\-funnel activity contributes to lower\-funnel conversions and feed that back into the plan
* Stay ahead of the Amazon advertising roadmap — beta features, new ad types, AMC releases — and bring the relevant ones into how we operate


**Partner \& Cross\-Functional Leadership**
* Communicate with partners via email, calls, and face\-to\-face meetings — bring insight, not just updates
* Define compelling advertising strategies that meet partner commercial goals and articulate them clearly to non\-specialist audiences
* Work closely with Brand Management, Merchandising, and SEO/Content to drive an aligned commercial agenda for your accounts — advertising is one lever, not the whole story


**Team \& Function**
* Train, develop, and coach more junior strategists and the offshore execution team — quality\-check work, raise the bar on standards, and build playbooks others can reuse
* Support the Lead on partner escalations, portfolio reviews, and strategic initiatives across the team
* Adopt internal tools and feed requirements back to the tech team to make the team faster and sharper


**Must\-Have**
* 5\+ years of total experience, with 3\+ years in a hands\-on digital advertising role on Amazon — agency, accelerator, or in\-house at a meaningful scale
* Demonstrable track record of owning accounts and carrying performance targets — you have held a number and hit it, not just reported on one
* Deep working knowledge of the Amazon advertising ecosystem — Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, and DSP
* Hands\-on experience with Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC) — or strong fluency in clean\-room / advanced advertising analytics and willingness to certify within the first 90 days
* Line management or senior mentoring experience — you have raised the performance of people around you
* Strategic thinker with a strong commercial bias — you can connect a bid adjustment to a P\&L outcome and explain it to a non\-specialist
* Excellent verbal and written communication — you can lead a partner conversation and write a sharp performance narrative
* Excellent analytical skills, including budget management and attention to detail
* Proactive and self\-directed — comfortable operating with autonomy across a portfolio and raising your hand before being asked


**Nice to Have**
* Experience working with retail / ecommerce brands across multiple categories
* Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC) certification
* Working knowledge of SQL for advertising data analysis
* Experience with BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Quicksight)
* Experience working with offshore execution teams or across geographies

title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
**What We Do** 




 FlytBase builds the world's leading drone autonomy software, powering operations for 300\+ customers in 40\+ countries—including Fortune 500 companies like Xcel Energy, Airbus, and Anglo American. Check out some of our critical deployments here.
 



  





 Headquartered in California with a fast\-moving engineering base in Pune, FlytBase is powering the shift from human\-operated to self\-driven skies. The company operates at AI speed, with autonomy and intelligence at its core. Our lean team works in a high\-agency, high\-velocity environment where AI isn't a side project, it's the operating system for how we think, build, and grow.
 



  





**The Role** 




 As Product Marketing Manager at FlytBase, you'll be the bridge between what we build and how the market understands it. You'll own positioning and messaging across verticals—translating deep technical capabilities into language that resonates with enterprise buyers in energy, utilities, security, and infrastructure. You'll arm sales with materials that actually get used, turn customer wins into compelling proof points, and ensure every product launch lands with clarity and impact.
 



  





 This role lives in the messy middle between product, sales, and the market. You'll spend as much time talking to customers and prospects as you do with internal teams. You'll need to understand the technical details well enough to distill them into buyer language—which is why a background in drones, robotics, or a related technical field will help you ramp fast and earn credibility quickly.
 



  





 The right person for this role has sharp marketing instincts, genuine curiosity about the product, and the ability to context\-switch between a product spec doc and a sales call without missing a beat.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




 • Positioning and messaging—sharpening how FlytBase talks about itself across verticals, personas, and use cases. You'll define the narrative, not just document it.
 



 • Sales enablement—battlecards, pitch decks, one\-pagers, objection handling guides, and competitive comparisons. The stuff sales actually pulls up before a call.
 



 • Product launches—working cross\-functionally with product, engineering, and marketing to ensure new features and releases land with the right story, materials, and market awareness.
 



 • Competitive intelligence—tracking the landscape, understanding alternatives, and keeping sales and leadership informed on how we win (and where we're vulnerable).
 



 • Customer evidence—building a library of case studies, testimonials, and reference customers that make the value tangible.
 



 • Buyer and market research—understanding what enterprise buyers care about, how they evaluate solutions, and what's blocking deals.
 



 • Partner marketing—working with 50\+ integration partners to ensure co\-marketing efforts are consistent, accurate, and compelling.
 



  





**Best Suited For** 




 • 2\-4 years in product marketing, preferably in B2B SaaS, enterprise tech, or technical products.
 



 • Drone, robotics, or electronics background strongly preferred. If you've worked in or around hardware, autonomous systems, or industrial tech, you'll hit the ground running.
 



 • At minimum, a technical background that lets you read a product spec, understand an integration, and translate it for a non\-technical buyer.
 



 • Experience working closely with sales—you understand deal cycles, objections, and what reps actually need to close.
 



 • Strong messaging instincts—you can take a complex technical differentiator and turn it into a sentence a buyer remembers.
 



 • Customer\-facing comfort—you'd rather be on a call with a customer or prospect than in an internal planning meeting.
 



 • Experience with AI tools for research, writing, and presentation creation is expected. You use them to move faster, not as a crutch.
 



  





**What Makes You a Flyter** 




 • Customer obsession: You learn more from one customer call than from a week of internal meetings. You're always looking for excuses to talk to the market.
 



 • Sales partner, not sales support: You work with sales, not for them. You'll push back on bad messaging requests and propose better alternatives.
 



 • Clarity as craft: You believe good positioning is a competitive advantage. You sweat the words because you know a single sentence can change a deal.
 



 • Technical credibility: You can sit in a product review and follow along. Engineers and PMs respect your input because you've done the homework.
 



 • Launch discipline: You don't just announce features—you ensure the market understands why they matter and sales knows how to sell them.
 



 • Competitive awareness: You always know what the other players are saying and how we stack up. Not out of anxiety—out of clarity.
 



  





**What We Don't Want** 




 • Marketers who treat sales enablement as a chore rather than a lever for revenue.
 



 • People who create decks and documents that sit in a folder and never get used.
 



 • PMMs who avoid direct customer contact and rely only on secondhand insights.
 



 • Anyone who needs a technical co\-pilot to understand what we're building. You should be able to get 80% of the way there yourself.
 



 • Folks who wait for product to hand them messaging instead of proposing it themselves.
 



 • "Process people" who need perfect inputs before they can create outputs. If you can't handle ambiguity, this isn't the place.
 



  





**Why FlytBase?** 




 • H3 Philosophy: We're building a company that's Happy, Healthy, AND High\-Performing. Not as a balance—as a harmony. We move fast without burning out.
 



 • Radical Ownership: You won't need permission to experiment, build, or lead. If you see a problem, you own the solution.
 



 • Mazaa Aayega: Our internal motto. Yes, the work is intense. But it's also deeply meaningful and genuinely fun.
 



 • Systems That Scale: We don't celebrate one\-off heroics. We build compounding systems that create leverage.
 



 • In\-Person Energy: We work from our Pune office because proximity accelerates everything—ideas, feedback, trust, and impact, but travel globally for customer meetings, tradeshows, and deployments.
 



  





**The Perks** 




 • High agency team and sense of purpose
 



 • International Travel—we travel to all 6 continents (sorry, no business in Antarctica yet)
 



 • Thought leadership \& public speaking opportunities at online \& physical events
 



 • No\-cap budget for AI tools, courses, or experiments
 



 • Latest tech stack and tools—whatever helps you move faster
 



 • Family Day—Once a year, we transform our office to showcase our work to the people who matter most
 



 • Top\-tier health coverage for you
 



 • Unlimited leave policy \& flexible working hours (no punch\-in/out)

* People leadership exposure with experience mentoring or managing associates (preferred).

description:
Social Media Marketing Specialist – Job Description
   

 Position: Social Media Marketing Specialist
   

 Experience: Minimum 2\+ Years
   

 Salary Package: ₹4 – ₹6 LPA
   

 Department: Digital Marketing / Social Media
   

 Employment Type: Full\-Time
   

 About the Role
   

 We are looking for an experienced and results\-driven Social Media Marketing Specialist with 2\+ years of hands\-on experience in social media marketing, social media management, and paid advertising.
   

 The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Meta Ads (Facebook \& Instagram Ads), social media strategy, content planning, audience targeting, campaign optimization, and performance analysis. The candidate should be capable of independently managing social media accounts and executing campaigns that contribute to brand awareness, engagement, lead generation, and business growth.
   

 Key Responsibilities
   

 Develop and execute effective social media marketing strategies based on brand and business objectives.
   

 Manage social media accounts across platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, and other relevant platforms.
   

 Plan and manage monthly content calendars and ensure timely execution.
   

 Coordinate with content writers, graphic designers, and video editors to develop engaging social media content.
   

 Create, manage, monitor, and optimize Meta Ads campaigns across Facebook and Instagram.
   

 Develop effective audience targeting strategies, including interest\-based, custom, and lookalike audiences.
   

 Monitor key advertising metrics such as CPC, CPM, CTR, CPL, conversions, reach, engagement, and ROAS.
   

 Conduct A/B testing of creatives, copy, audiences, placements, and campaign strategies.
   

 Optimize campaigns based on performance data to improve results and control advertising costs.
   

 Manage social media engagement, comments, messages, and audience interactions.
   

 Research competitors, industry trends, and audience behaviour to identify new marketing opportunities.
   

 Identify relevant trends, content formats, hashtags, and topics to improve organic reach and engagement.
   

 Analyze social media and advertising performance and prepare regular reports.
   

 Provide actionable recommendations to improve content and campaign performance.
   

 Stay updated with Meta Ads updates, algorithm changes, new features, advertising policies, and social media trends.
   

 Ensure all social media activities are aligned with the brand's identity, communication style, and marketing objectives.
   

 Required Skills \& Experience
   

 Minimum 2\+ years of professional experience in Social Media Marketing and Social Media Management.
   

 Strong hands\-on experience with Meta Ads Manager and Facebook/Instagram advertising.
   

 Excellent understanding of Meta Ads campaign setup, audience targeting, retargeting, budgeting, optimization, and reporting.
   

 Experience managing social media pages for brands or businesses.
   

 Strong understanding of content strategy, content planning, and social media marketing.
   

 Knowledge of social media analytics and performance metrics.
   

 Ability to analyze campaign data and make data\-driven decisions.
   

 Good understanding of organic and paid social media marketing.
   

 Strong communication and coordination skills.
   

 Ability to manage multiple accounts, campaigns, and deadlines simultaneously.
   

 Creative mindset with strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
   

 Preferred Skills
   

 Experience handling multiple brands or clients.
   

 Experience with lead\-generation and conversion\-focused Meta Ads campaigns.
   

 Knowledge of Google Analytics and other digital marketing analytics tools.
   

 Familiarity with social media scheduling and management tools.
   

 Basic understanding of SEO and digital marketing.
   

 Knowledge of Canva or other creative tools is an added advantage.
   

 Experience working in a digital marketing or advertising agency will be preferred.
   

 Key Performance Areas
   

 Meta Ads campaign performance
   

 Lead generation and conversions
   

 Cost per lead and overall campaign efficiency
   

 Social media growth and engagement
   

 Content performance
   

 Audience growth and reach
   

 Campaign ROI/ROAS
   

 Quality and consistency of social media management
   

 Timely execution of content calendars and campaigns
   

 Salary \& Growth
   

 Salary Package: ₹4 – ₹6 LPA
   

 The final salary offered will depend on the candidate's experience, skill set, practical knowledge, and performance during the interview process.
   

 What We Offer
   

 Opportunity to work on multiple brands and diverse campaigns.
   

 Hands\-on exposure to Meta Ads, social media strategy, content marketing, and digital advertising.
   

 Opportunity to work in a dynamic and creative digital marketing environment.
   

 Professional growth and learning opportunities.
   

 Performance\-based career growth.
   

 How to Apply
   

 Interested candidates can share their updated resume along with their social media portfolio or details of Meta Ads campaigns they have managed.
   

 Candidates with strong hands\-on experience in Meta Ads and Social Media Management are encouraged to apply.

title: Marketing Operations Associate I
description:
**Our Mission**
 Healthcare should work for patients, but it doesn’t. In their time of need, they call down outdated insurance directories. Then wait on hold. Then wait weeks for the privilege of a visit. Then wait in a room solely designed for waiting. Then wait for a surprise bill. In any other consumer industry, the companies delivering such a poor customer experience would not survive. But in healthcare, patients lack market power. Which means they are expected to accept the unacceptable.
   

  

 Zocdoc’s mission is to give power to the patient. To do that, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace that makes it easy to find and book in\-person or virtual care in all 50 states, across 200\+ specialties and \+12k insurance plans. By giving patients the ability to see and choose, we give them power. In doing so, we can make healthcare work like every other consumer sector, where businesses compete for customers, not the other way around. In time, this will drive quality up and prices down.
   

  

 We’re 18 years old and the leader in our space, but we are still just getting started. If you like solving important, complex problems alongside deeply thoughtful, driven, and collaborative teammates, read on.
   

  

**Your Impact On Our Mission**
 The Marketing Operations team supports marketing functions across the organization. You’ll play a critical role in helping to grow our lifecycle marketing program. Your work will play an integral part in driving provider acquisition, engagement and retention via thoughtful, tailored experiences by leading execution and reporting across email marketing campaigns.
   

  

**You’ll enjoy this role if you are…**
* A confident and adaptive learner
* Loves getting into the details and takes pride in making sure every email looks perfect and functions flawlessly
* Enjoys working behind the scenes to bring marketing campaigns to life and collaborating with cross\-functional teams to make it all happen
* Finds satisfaction in process, organization, and using marketing automation tools to turn ideas into polished, on\-brand experiences
* Energized by working on projects that are in development, presenting new angles that require fresh approaches
* Meticulous (great attention to detail!) in planning and executing projects across multiple departments
* A good communicator and multitasker
* Someone who values the sweet spot between structure, independence, and improvisation
* Enthusiastic about AI and eager to use AI\-powered tools to improve efficiency, creativity, and campaign execution


**Your Day to Day Is…**
* Build, test, and deploy email campaigns in platforms such as Marketo and Braze, ensuring high\-quality execution and flawless delivery
* Manage audience segmentation and list uploads based on campaign requirements and behavioral/demographic data
* Perform rigorous QA on all email assets, including content proofing, link validation, and dynamic content testing
* Set up campaign tracking parameters and assist in monitoring performance metrics (open rates, CTRs, conversions, etc.)
* Collaborate closely with lifecycle, creative, and analytics teams to execute campaigns on time and aligned with brand standards
* Help maintain the health of our marketing databases by supporting list hygiene and contact management practices.
* Building marketing campaigns end\-to\-end, primarily through email and in product channels
* Coding new HTML emails from design files
* Thinking critically about audience segmentation and campaign performance \& to ensure that the campaign setup matches the goals in the campaign briefs
* Building reports/performing analysis
* Participating in meetings with project stakeholders
* Executing ad hoc and short\-term project initiatives


**You’d be Successful in This Role if You Have…**
* A Bachelor’s degree from a top tier institution with a minimum of 60% in 10th/12th/ graduation
* 1\-3 years of work experience
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Strong attention to detail and comfort with Q/A processes
* Ability to manage multiple projects and timelines in a fast\-paced environment
* Data\-orientation: Understanding which data is relevant, asking the right questions, and data literacy
* Advanced proficiency in MS Excel/Google Sheets
* Independent problem\-solving capabilities
* Experience in a previous marketing operations/production role is preferred
* Experience with marketing automation platforms like Marketo, Salesforce, Braze, Mailgun preferred


**Benefits**
* An incredible team of smart and supportive people
* A competitive compensation package, including attractive medical insurance
* Amazing perks – think catered lunch every day, Ping Pong, etc.
* Daycare reimbursement
* The chance to create a better healthcare experience for millions of patients!
* Cellphone and wifi reimbursement
* Competitive parental leave
* Sabbatical leave (over 5 years)
* Annual sponsored health check\-ups
* Zocdoc is certified as a Great Place to Work 2022\-2026


**About Us**
 Zocdoc is the country’s leading digital health marketplace that helps patients easily find and book the care they need. Each month, millions of patients use our free service to find nearby, in\-network providers, compare choices based on verified patient reviews, and instantly book in\-person or video visits online. Providers participate in Zocdoc’s Marketplace to reach new patients to grow their practice, fill their last\-minute openings, and deliver a better healthcare experience. Founded in 2007 with a mission to give power to the patient, our work each day in pursuit of that mission is guided by our six core values. Zocdoc is a private company backed by some of the world’s leading investors, and we believe we’re still only scratching the surface of what we plan to accomplish.
   

  

 Zocdoc is a mission\-driven organization dedicated to building teams as diverse as the patients and providers we aim to serve. In the spirit of one of our core values \-
 *Together, Not Alone* 
 , we are a company that prides itself on being highly collaborative, and we believe that diverse perspectives, experiences and contributors make our community and our platform better. We’re an equal opportunity employer committed to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. Applicants are considered for employment regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, veteran status, or any other class protected by applicable laws.

title: Senior Marketing Analyst, Reporting & Insights
description:
The Senior Marketing Analyst, Reporting \& Insights is the senior measurement and reporting owner for Showpad's marketing organization. This person is trusted to take a reporting question from ambiguous, scattered data all the way to an accurate, board\-ready answer and to stand behind every number.
   

  

 Beyond building dashboards, this role identifies where the data actually lives across our platforms, leads the effort to bring the right data into Salesforce as the system of record, and builds reliable reporting from there. It is also an early adopter of AI: using tools such as Claude Cowork to automate recurring reporting and manual data preparation, while holding a high bar for accuracy. The goal is to convert repetitive, manual work into trustworthy automation so the team can spend its time solving business problems and mastering the platforms — not assembling spreadsheets.
   

  

 This is a role for a self\-directed go\-getter who is comfortable operating with ambiguity, figuring out who owns the answer to a question, and chasing it down across teams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Board \& Executive Reporting**
* Own recurring board\-, QBR\-, and Marketing Leadership\-level reporting: pipeline, funnel performance, campaign effectiveness, channel performance, ROMI, and marketing's contribution to revenue.
* Translate complex, multi\-source data into clear, accurate, executive\-ready narratives and dashboards for the CMO, Senior Director of Marketing Operations, and board\-level discussions.
* Prepare inputs for board decks, planning cycles, and business reviews, and be accountable for the accuracy of every figure presented.
* Establish QA and validation routines so executive reporting reconciles consistently across systems and can be trusted without re\-checking.


**Cross\-Source Data Identification \& Salesforce Integration**
* Identify and map the data required for reporting across multiple platforms — Marketo, Salesforce, product usage, web analytics (GA4\), ABM/intent, enrichment, and finance systems.
* Lead the charge to get the right marketing\-level data into Salesforce as the system of record — defining fields, objects, mappings, and integration requirements in partnership with Revenue Operations.
* Own reporting from Salesforce once data lands, ensuring metric definitions and funnel\-stage logic are consistent end to end.
* Troubleshoot data discrepancies, sync errors, and gaps across the Marketo\-to\-Salesforce integration and connected systems.


**AI\-Enabled Reporting \& Automation**
* Use AI tools (Claude Cowork or similar) to automate recurring reporting requests and manual data\-preparation work.
* Design automation with accuracy built in — source\-of\-truth checks, validation, and human QA — so speed never comes at the cost of trust in the numbers.
* Continuously convert manual, repetitive reporting tasks into reliable automated workflows, reinvesting the reclaimed time into deeper analysis, platform mastery, and business problem\-solving.
* Share AI\-enabled reporting practices with the broader marketing team and help raise the team's overall automation maturity.


**Performance Measurement \& Attribution**
* Build, maintain, and optimize marketing dashboards in Salesforce and visualization tools.
* Own and refine attribution models (multi\-touch/single\-touch) that evaluate marketing's influence on revenue.
* Ensure funnel definitions and stage movements are accurate and consistent across the tech stack.


**Strategic Insights \& Optimization**
* Conduct diagnostic analyses (cohort, funnel, segmentation, content and channel performance) to explain the “why” behind the numbers.
* Analyze spend efficiency to advise leadership on where to invest, optimize, or pull back across channels.
* Support revenue modeling, forecasting, and scenario planning in partnership with Revenue Operations and Finance.


**Data Governance \& Stakeholder Navigation**
* Maintain documentation for metric definitions, naming conventions, and data taxonomy to keep the organization aligned; recommend improvements to marketing data architecture.
* Operate as a self\-directed go\-getter: proactively determine who owns the answer to a question and pursue it across Marketing, Revenue Operations, Sales, Finance, and IT until resolved.
* Act as the go\-to expert for interpreting marketing data and enables the team to read dashboards and self\-serve.


**Required Qualifications**
* 5\-7\+ years in marketing analytics, revenue operations, or business intelligence, ideally within a B2B SaaS environment.
* Demonstrated experience preparing board\- or executive\-level marketing reporting, including ownership of accuracy.
* Experience with ARR, pipeline, and funnel reporting in B2B SaaS.
* Advanced Salesforce reporting, with proven experience bringing data from multiple sources into Salesforce (field/object design, integrations) and building reporting from it.
* Hands\-on experience using AI tools (Claude Cowork or similar) to automate reporting or analysis while maintaining reporting accuracy.
* Strong technical grasp of the Lead\-to\-Revenue funnel, including conversion rates, velocity, and multi\-touch attribution logic.
* Proficiency with data visualization tools (AWS QuickSight preferred) and Google Suite.
* Hands\-on experience with marketing automation platforms (Marketo preferred) and how they integrate with CRM and web analytics (GA4 preferred).
* Exceptional data storytelling: the ability to turn complex findings into clear, “so\-what” narratives for executive audiences.
* Communicate complex data mapping and reconciliation efforts clearly to both technical and business audiences.
* Self\-directed and comfortable with ambiguity — able to figure out who to talk to and drive to answers without being handed the path.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with attribution platforms or intent data providers (e.g., Full Circle Insights, Bizible, Qualified).
* Track record of building reporting automations or AI\-assisted workflows in a marketing or RevOps setting.
* Experience partnering closely with Revenue Operations, Sales Ops, and/or Finance.


**Working Style**
* A go\-getter who takes ownership of turning ambiguous questions into accurate answers.
* Obsessive about reporting accuracy; treats board\-level numbers as sacred.
* A pragmatic adopter of AI — automates the manual, protects the accurate, and frees time for higher\-value work.
* Comfortable operating across teams and driving to resolution in a fast\-moving environment.

title: Head of Marketing

 Chellaram Hospital Diabetes Care \& Multispeciality, part of Chellaram Diabetes Institute, provides integrated research, education, awareness, medical, and diagnostic services to address the growing burden of diabetes and related conditions. The hospital offers state\-of\-the\-art facilities under one roof, combining advanced clinical care with a strong focus on preventive health. The team leads community outreach initiatives, including mobile health clinics and wellness programs, to improve public health awareness. Experts at the institute conduct leading research in endocrinology and deliver training to health professionals, ensuring high standards of care. Patients remain at the center of all activities, reflected in the hospital’s values and commitment to compassionate, quality care.

 The Head of Marketing is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Pune Division, responsible for designing and executing the hospital’s overall marketing and communication strategy. This position leads the planning and implementation of campaigns that promote diabetes care, multispeciality services, and community health initiatives, ensuring alignment with organizational goals. Daily responsibilities include overseeing market research, developing annual marketing plans, managing brand positioning, and coordinating with clinical and administrative teams to support patient acquisition and retention. The role also involves managing public relations activities, supervising digital and offline marketing channels, collaborating with external agencies, and tracking performance metrics to optimize marketing ROI. The Head of Marketing will lead and mentor the marketing team, ensure adherence to ethical healthcare communication standards, and represent the hospital at key events and partnerships.

* Demonstrated expertise in Marketing Management and Market Planning, including strategic campaign design and execution.

* Strong ethical judgment and commitment to patient\-centered, non\-misleading healthcare communication.

title: Regional Global Account Manager (m/f/d)

title: Unit Manager - Digital Platforms and Consumer AI/Senior Unit Manager - Digital Platforms and Consumer AI
description:
**Location Name:** 
 Pune Corporate Office \- Mantri
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 To own KPI tracking, measurement readiness, defect follow\-up and stakeholder coordination for assigned Bajaj App and Website modules. The role strengthens the POD operating model by translating module objectives into measurable dashboards, validating tracking requirements for Build initiatives and running a disciplined production monitoring cadence for customer experience, digital funnel and platform stability metrics.
   

  

**Duties And Responsibilities**
 PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES
   

  

**Minimum Required Accountabilities For This Role**
* Own KPI tracker and dashboard governance for assigned module across App and Website.
* Partner with Product Manager and Technology teams to validate event requirements, tracking plans, dashboard readiness and release acceptance criteria.
* Monitor funnel performance, CTR, conversion, task success, feature adoption, bounce rate, frustration score, crash\-free sessions and performance metrics.
* Coordinate defect closure, KPI breakage investigation and production issue follow\-up with Engineering, QA, Martech and TechOps.
* Prepare weekly module performance summaries with insights, risks, dependency status and action owners.


**Additional Accountabilities Pertaining To The Role**
* Identify recurring gaps in instrumentation, dashboards, releases or monitoring and recommend process improvements.
* Support sprint planning by highlighting KPI dependencies, reporting readiness and ageing blockers.
* Contribute to customer\-experience improvement ideas using behavioral analytics and platform performance data.


 KRA \& WEIGHTAGE
   

  

 KRA Area Weightage Primary Measures Outcome Expectation
   

  

 KPI Tracking \& Business Insights 25% CTR, conversion rate, feature adoption, funnel completion, reporting accuracy Maintain clear KPI visibility and identify drivers of performance movement.
   

  

 Production Run \& Defect Governance 20% Incident count, MTTR support, defect closure, defect leakage, API latency Improve defect closure discipline and reduce repeat KPI breakages.
   

  

 Build Readiness \& Sprint Support 15% Requirement readiness, user story acceptance criteria, release success rate Ensure all KPI requirements are testable and release\-ready.
   

  

 Customer Experience Analytics 15% Bounce rate, frustration score, rage clicks, task success, customer effort score Surface journey friction and support CX improvement actions.
   

  

 Stakeholder \& POD Governance 15% Dependency closure, escalation TAT, decision documentation Maintain cadence, action logs and accountable stakeholder follow\-up.
   

  

 Compliance \& Control 10% UAT evidence, SOP adherence, audit observations Ensure measurement and release documentation are audit\-ready.
   

  

**Key Decisions / Dimensions**
* Approve module\-level KPI readiness checklist for Product review.
* Recommend escalation of ageing defects, repeated KPI breakages and customer\-impacting performance deviations.
* Prioritize reporting fixes and analysis requests based on business impact and journey criticality.\|
* Direct financial ownership: Supports module targets by ensuring KPI visibility, funnel tracking and performance issue escalation.


**Major Challenges**
* Balancing sprint delivery support with daily run monitoring requires disciplined prioritization.
* KPI ownership depends on accurate instrumentation across multiple channels and tools.
* Stakeholder alignment is critical because defects and latency issues may sit across Product, Martech, IT and Engineering teams.


**Required Qualifications And Experience**
 SKILLS AND KNOWLEDGE
   

  

**Educational Qualifications**
* Engineer as base qualification: BE/B.Tech in Computer Science, IT, Electronics or related discipline preferred.
* Coding exposure is required; working knowledge of SQL, Python, JavaScript tagging concepts or shell scripting is preferred.
* Certification or hands\-on training in digital analytics, observability, product analytics, cloud monitoring or agile delivery is an added advantage.


 Work Experience
   

  

* Experience Range: 3\-6 years
* Experience in digital analytics, product operations, TechOps, app/web performance monitoring, UAT governance or business reporting.
* Hands\-on exposure to GA4, Firebase, CleverTap, Power BI, New Relic, Datadog, JIRA or Azure DevOps.
* Ability to convert data into actionable insights and coordinate closure across Product, Tech, Design and Martech teams.


 Tools / Platforms
   

  

* Azure DevOps, JIRA, GA4, CleverTap, Contentsquare, New Relic, Firebase, Power BI, Datadog, Figma, Zeplin, Adobe, DAM, CMS, KPI Portal, Medallia, Mixpanel, Postman and Splunk, with depth aligned to grade.


 Assumptions Used
   

  

* Experience range, reporting line and team size are aligned to the level framework and may be finalized by HR during role calibration.
